description:
1st Floor, NO ELEVATOR

A hidden oasis in Cihangir's center, this newly refurbished apartment offers a large terrace in the back of the building, overlooking trees and characteristic abandoned buildings.
2 bedrooms, a large living room and a lot of light, with modern full kitchen and furniture ensure a very comfortable stay for up to six guests.
A perfect hideout in the heart of hip city life, just a few minutes to any attraction you could be looking for.

reviews.text:
Murat was very responsive right from the start and gave me as much help & information as he possibly could.
The flat was just as described in photos. Incredibly clean, spacious, bright and comfortable. Convenient location yet very quiet as it was in a side street with very little traffic(The only time I had an issue with the noise was a guy downstairs playing music loudly. I went to politely asked him to turn it down, he did so without any issues).
Everything worked well. Even when we had a small problem with the boiler, he gave us instructions to get it going again.
If there is anything, there was no microwave or oven in the kitchen. So it was not possible to warm things up unless it's something like soup. Also, the airer for washed clothes on the terrace was rusty and broken. I asked the host for a replacement which never arrived.
All in all, it was an extremely pleasant stay and the price was fine split between 2 of us.
Definitely worth it and recommend it highly.

The apartment was located in a great area - quiet but close to the bustle of the city, lots of wonderful coffee shops. Check in was super easy, and the hosts were always very responsive to messages and friendly to talk to. Clean flat, and looks identical to the photos, minus the balcony which was not well maintained however that is likely due to the cute cat guests that love to sleep there. Overall good value for money.
Three issues arose from the stay however. The first being that in the smaller second bedroom, the sound of running water in the pipes was very loud and kept my friend up at night. The second issue was that there was a municipal problem in which water was cut off - this is understandably not the hosts fault however as a host it would have been helpful to have provided your guests with some bottled water during that time as we were unable to even brush our teeth from morning until 10pm. Lastly, we had an issue with the shower drain not draining water causing water to poo

I spent 2 weeks at Murat’s place. Checking in was a piece of cake; the flat was welcoming, exactly as described on the listing page, very clean, quiet and cozy. There is everything you need to settle in immediately, towels/ bed linen/soaps/cleaning material/all the kitchen utensils and supplies/Nespresso type machine/water boiler/oil-salt-pepper/washing machine/blackout curtains/excellent heating-warm water system/generous lighting/English-American type plugs. One had the impression to be invited to a friend’s flat that has done everything to make you feel at home. The neighbourhood is great, lots of markets, shops, cafes, restaurants, safe and just fun to walk in the streets and close to Taksim square uphill and Τophane downhill. The communication with the host was excellent, immediately responsive, allowing me a late checkout since the flat was not immediately taken. I will certainly be back, and am most grateful to my hosts for having offered me a trouble-free stay.

Murat provided very clear and concise check in instructions and was very quick to response to any questions we had. The place looked exactly like the pictures and was clean. Bathroom was clean and had good water pressure if you care about that sort of thing. Location was great with plenty of food options in the area including a supermarket. Close to Taksim square and the Bosphorus. The only thing I would note is while the terrace is great it was hard to use due to construction across from it. So during the work week if you are in the Airbnb you may hear some construction related noise but you probably should be out exploring the city anyway.

Travelled to Istanbul over the Easter period with my 2 teenager children. Murat's apartment is in a perfect location really close to the Tram T1 (sort of a hike on the way back home) and very close to Taksim Metro square. Plenty of nice little restaurants and cafe in the neighbourhood. The apartment is very new, decorated with taste and found it extremely clean. I cooked several times and the kitchen was fully functional (dishwasher included). Netflix and WI-FI worked perfectly (joy for my kids). The beds were comfortable and the shower had a good water jet. Did not use the terrace since I didn't think it was the best part of the apartment and the view is not that great. The key holder was super responsive and helpful with practical information. Over the week end the area can get a little noisy with music playing from the surrounding bars. Keep in mind for summer stays that currently there is no air conditioning (we didn't need it). Overall I would strongly recommend Murat's apartment!

description:
Fantastic apartment in the heart of Ortaköy, right next to tourist attractions! In this home where modern comfort and elegance converge, you are just one step away from the heartbeat of the city. Explore the symbols of Istanbul, savor the atmosphere of cafes and markets. Immerse yourself in the city's dynamism, perfect for a comfortable stay.

-Fully furnished with luxury and new equipments
-Natural backyard and perfectly isolated chat atmosphere
-Cozy and compact space

reviews.text:
Konum çok iyi zaten konumu ve her yere yakınlığından dolayı burayı tercih etmiştik. Konumu haricinde hizmet olarak bu fiyatı haketmediğini düşünüyorum (sanıyorum kendileri de bunun rahatlığındalar). Araç parkı konusunda sıkıntılı biraz, dar sokaklar. Ama köprünün altında kolayca park yeri bulabildim (özel otopark ücretleri çok pahalı ve anlaşmaları yok sanırım).
Öncelikle verdikleri telefon numarasını her aradığımda ulaşılamıyordu, mecbur airbnb üzerinden iletişime geçtik.
Odada saç kurutma makinesi ve ütü yoktu istedikten sonra gönderildi.
Banyo havlusu, ayak havlusu, terlik ve nevresim yoktu sonra gönderildi. Bunların hepsini konaklayan misafir istemeli sanırım…
Klima kendi kendine açılmış odada kumandası yoktu nasıl oldugunu anlamadık. Şalteri indirmek zorunda kaldık. Artık tekrar bu konuda da iletişime geçmek istemedim.
Çekmecenin içinde izmarit ve küller, yerde popcornlar vardı.
Boğaziçi köprüsü manzaralı dediği köprü direği manzaralı. Oda zemin kattı.
Vasat temizlik ve hizmet.

Evin konumu harikaydı. Fotoğrafta göründüğü gibi rahat ve konforlu bir evdi. 2 gece konakladık ve herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Ortaköy sahile çok yakın sabah ve akşam vakitlerinde rahatça gezip eve dönebilirsiniz. Sessiz ve sakin bir muhitti. Temizlik konusunda bazı eksiklikler vardı ama rahatsız edecek boyutta değildi. Yedek tuvalet kağıdı olmalı evde bir de terliksiz yerlere basmak mümkün değildi çünkü aşırı derecede karınca vardı. Aslında ev sahibinin değil de burada konaklama yapan insanların kullanımıyla alakalı bir durumu daha paylaşmak istiyorum; yediği içtiği şeylerin çöpünü koltukların arasına atan insanların sağlıklı olduğunu düşünmüyorum, çöplerini çöpe atarsın koltuğun altına atmazsın. Evin temizliği yapılırken koltuk araları ve altına dikkat edilmesini tavsiye ediyorum. Bir sonraki misafir bu kötü durumlara şahit olmamalı.
My stay at this house was a good experience. The house was just like in the photos, modern, minimal and clean. Check-in was smooth. The host was communicative and helpful.

Incredibly dirty and unclean building before you got into the flat. The flat itself was not clean either - lots of stains on the sofa and carpet. Hair in the bed, and there was a plastic mattress cover that meant that the bed was super hot. The curtains didn't close completely and we had to clip them shut. Finally there were a lot of maintenance issues - wall stains, no boundaries on the doors, gaps in the flooring, the WiFi router was hanging from the ceiling. We did not feel comfortable being there

I highly recommend this apartment!!! modern, cozy, quiet, and most importantly, clean, with wonderful views of the bridge (especially at night). The apartment matches the photo. The apartment has bed linen, towels, shampoo and so on. The owner is very pleasant to talk to, our requests were quickly answered. Overall we felt at home. We will definitely come back 🫶. we really liked it a lot

description:
Hello, First of all, Welcome!

This house, which you can see in the images, is very close to the sea and is in the historical district of KADIKOY. It is on the Asian side of Istanbul. It is very central (very close to all public transportation) and at the same time in a quiet and peaceful location.
Kadıköy is the best and central place in Istanbul on the Asian side. It's very lively even at night with many cool bars and cafes. The people are friendly. Coffee shops and art stores are also on the street of this house where you will stay.
Our house is in the most CENTRAL part of Kadıköy.

reviews.text:
Pros:
* Clean and cozy with two spacious bedrooms.
* Excellent location near public transport (Metro, Ferry, Bus).
* Variety of restaurants and cafes nearby.
* Friendly and responsive hosts.
Cons:
* Internet may be adequate for streaming (~25Mbps) but not for work; no dedicated workspace, despite listing details.
* Fourth-floor location accessible only via steep spiral stairs, not mentioned in the description. This could be a significant inconvenience for guests with mobility issues or the elderly.
* No air conditioning; uncomfortable during the hot days.
* Significant noise from bars below until early morning (even 3am).
Overall, while the apartment has many metirs, potential guests should consider these factors to ensure it meets their expectations.

Ev güzel, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi geniş, ferah ve temiz. 5-6 kişi rahatlıkla konaklayabilir. Ancak mutfaktaki pişirme ekipmanları (tencereler, bıçak vs.) ne yazık ki yetersiz, çizikler içinde, yağlı ve eski. Bulaşık makinesi olmaması da dezavantaj. Evin konumu iyi Kadıköy’deki birçok yere yürüme mesafesi, metro, vapur ve metrobüse yakın. Yalnızca sokağın alt tarafının türkü bar ve gazino benzeri mekanlarla dolu olması biraz rahatsız edici. Bu mekanlardan gece 3-4’e kadar müzik sesi geliyor. Eğer kalabalıksanız, turistik amaçlı geldiyseniz ve sesle bir probleminiz yoksa tam bir f/p evi. Biz eşimle iki kişi kaldığımız için bizim için tam bir f/p oldu diyemem.
The apartment was clean, as described, and in a great location (very close to bus terminal and ferry). Mehmet was friendly, flexible, and very accommodating with us to sort out some booking issues.

4th floor, no elevator but otherwise a perfect location.
Very good shower.
Host responded immediately to all queries and was very helpful.

Öncelikle ev sahibiyle hiçbir iletişim sıkıntısı yaşamadım ki bence konaklama kadar önemli bir husus bu. Evin konumu cok güzel İstanbul'a aşina olmasanız da ihtiyaçlarınızı karşılayabileceğiniz merkezi bir yerde. Ev temizlik ve hijyen açısından tam puan verilecek şekildeydi gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.

description:
Our historical building is located on the iconic 'Adile Naşit' street in Istanbul's cultural district of Cihangir. We hope that this apartment will create a beautiful memory for your stay in Istanbul with its meticulous design.

More than a hotel, our apartments provide a true home in the heart of the world's most exciting city, blending authenticity, freedom, attentive service and unwavering comfort.

Welcome to your home in Istanbul!

reviews.text: This place is very cozy and has very old Turkish vibes. Incredibly clean, first night I could also smell the scent of the blankets. The main reason why I choose this place was its position, in the beautiful neighborhood of Cihangir, in the centre of Istanbul but also enclosed in a little street where there are no restaurants or other shops and cars they cannot access, so very quite during the night. But I was wrong. The noise is not coming from outside, but from inside of the apartment. The heater makes a constant noise, even when is not working, we also tried to switch off the electricity power from the control panel but nothing. There is an auto mode that we off from the remote controller but anyway suddenly the heater starts working during the night, waking me up. So I end up my trip not sleeping for 4 nights. the bed was two mattress together and very tough. Also you can hear people steps from upstairs. Hosts are very nice they tried to help but unfortunately nothing could change.

We have stayed for a week in this beautiful apartment in Cihangir. It has mostly pluses, but also a couple of minuses.
+ Easiest arrival in my experience - all code-based and smooth
+ The host has provided all the necessary supplies for hygiene
+ The apartment is very clean and cosy - especially the sofa area
+ An amazing spot with many local cafes, hamams, bars, and vintage shops - very close to Istiklal, Cucurkuma, and other streets that are a must-see
+ Close to Taksim square - easy to get anywhere by bus or metro
- The internet has worked only in the Iiving room and for only one day of our week stay. Although the host tried to fix it, it did not work - we advice to buy an eSIM with the internet for your comfort
- The TV is unfortunately useless as it has no regular channels, and only connects to YouTube/Netflix through the WiFi that did not work
- You can hear the steps of the guests living over you
Overall, we really enjoyed the stay, and small minuses did not spoil it a bit! 💕

This was truly a good find.
Pros: Excellent location (from taksim you walk mostly straight and then some downwards for about 8-10 min. On the way back it’s slightly uphill but not too bad, but if preferred its possible to walk downwards all the way to tophane tram station in 10-15 min.
The apartment is really spacious with great height. It had a small useful kitchen, a large bedroom and a nice sized living room. The toilet and bathroom is also separate, which i can imagine is good if you travel with someone else.
Cons:
The wifi wasn’t the best, but not something i minded too much as i had cellullar.
A few of the tiles in the toilet and bathroom floors (a handful, nothing crazy) were gone, and the bathroom sink was a little loose. This didn’t hinder the usefulness at all, but from an aesthetic perspective were points i noticed.
These are also really old apartments, so the floors are squeaky and you can hear people walking in the apartment upstairs well.
All in all, i’d book again

Staying in this lovely and very comfortable apartment with its elegant woodwork and atmospheric stained glass is like time-travelling back to early 20th century Istanbul (except for its modern kitchen and bathroom). It is in a great neighbourhood, in easy walking distance of Taksim Square and public transport options. The building is quiet and secure, up some steps in a cul de sac. The surrounding streets have plenty of good restaurants and interesting shops, and there is a small supermarket and a fruit and vegetable shop very close. A wonderful place to stay.

Firat and foremost CLEAN . They provided hotel slippers and the floor didn't even left a stain on them. Kitchen is more than enough, they even got a sauce pan (c'mon). So beautifully decorated that we couldn't left house without a second thought, even though we were determined to explore Cihangir. Hosts are responsive, It says usually responds in 30 minutes but my experience it was much shorter on average, 2 minutes. Thanks again for the experience!

description:
Modern Elegance meets Central Comfort! This 150m² designer flat is located in a flat area (no hills!) just steps from Istiklal Street. Featuring 3 master bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom and independent AC, it offers perfect privacy for groups and families. Enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and a professional stay in a seismic-reinforced building with an elevator.

FREE VIP Airport Transfer for 10+ night stays!

reviews.text:
Enes and the entire team were professional and very friendly. They were quick to respond to any questions we had. The apartment itself was clean and perfect for what we wanted. Three en suite bedrooms, small kitchen, living room, secure entrance etc. There's a cafe with awesome music right downstairs and I made sure to get a coffee and enjoy the ambience every day. A small market across the street provided everything we needed for our week-long stay.
The thermostats went out for a night due to electrical issues in the neighborhood and the hosts immediately provided us with a heater.
There was some construction going on nearby and that caused some noise early morning, but that wasn't something you wouldn't encounter in any major city anywhere in the world.
In short, we will undoubtedly keep this location top of mind for our next trip, and highly recommend them to anyone looking to rent a place in Istanbul.
Thank you to Enes and team for a great experience!

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul! The location is absolutely perfect—just a short walk from Taksim Square, which made it incredibly convenient to explore the city, access public transport, and enjoy all the local restaurants, shops, and attractions nearby.
The hosts were exceptional—very responsive, kind, and always checked in to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. It really made us feel welcome and cared for throughout the stay.
The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described in the listing. Despite being in a lively and central area, the inside was quiet and cozy—perfect for relaxing after a day of sightseeing.
Overall, this stay exceeded our expectations. Great hospitality, unbeatable location, and everything we needed for a comfortable and memorable time in Istanbul. Highly recommend!

We had a fantastic stay here!
Location: Just a 2-minute walk from Istiklal Street, surrounded by plenty of restaurants and shops. There’s also a supermarket right in front of the building and a cozy coffee shop downstairs — very convenient.
Apartment: The place is super comfortable, with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, which made it perfect for our group. Everything was spotless and well-maintained.
Host: Extremely responsive and accommodating. They allowed us to check in early, which was a huge help. They even left coffee pods and water in the fridge, a really thoughtful touch.
Overall, a wonderful stay — highly recommend!

I traveled with my entire family, and I really wanted a place that was family oriented and very safe. I am glad I chose to stay here. The place is safe, easy to get by, there is a groceries store right opposite the property. Also, there is so much activity especially many brand shops. The house is located 1 minutes' walk from the main Istkilal street, My teenage kids had a lot to do with their shopping money. The house was spacious enough for us, the beds were comfortable and the water pressure was very good, which is usually my only issue with many other spaces. It was clean and the host was very responsive when i reached out to him. The guys down at the Trinity cafe are so lovely, we even got a free loaf of bread and tea while we waited to check in. I would definately stay here again, even as a solo traveller. Thank you so much Enes for opening your home to us.

Great stay overall. The host was very responsive and helpful. The location is excellent, just a few minutes from Istiklal Street, and the apartment was clean and exactly as described. Highly recommended.

description: The perfect place for our guests to fully enjoy the Istanbul experience! Luxurious accommodation in a stylish building right next to Taksim Square, with all the building facilities including a gym, pool, sauna and much more! The building is like a hotel with a very well-designed, beautiful reception area and 24/7 security. Discover the spirit of the city in Taksim's lively atmosphere with our modern, comfortable apartment with all amenities.

reviews.text:
“We had a wonderful stay and would happily come back. The apartment was actually even better than the photos and exceeded our expectations. The view was spectacular, and we especially loved spending time on the balcony. The unit was very clean, the beds were comfortable, and the kitchen was well equipped for our needs. There were just a few small items that would have made things even more convenient, like salt and pepper and an oven mitt. These were minor details and didn’t affect our overall experience. During our stay, the building experienced a few water outages, but this seemed to be beyond the host’s control, so we don’t consider it a negative reflection on them. One of the highlights was the excellent building staff. The 24/7 security team was professional, welcoming, and always helpful. We also enjoyed the pool and the other facilities, which were clean, well-maintained. Overall, we had a fantastic experience and truly enjoyed our time here.
Highly recommended.

The house was clean and as described in the listing. The building had all the modern amenities and there was a reception which was very helpful.
The apartment and the neighboring area was extremely safe.
Metro was around 1 km away, so since we had older people in our group we had to rely on a taxi as opposed to the public transport.
Overall it was a very pleasant stay and everything stood up to expectations, would definitely stay again and recommend this place to others.

If you’re seeking value for money then this will be the rental for you.
Facilities: it’s a spacious apartment but would benefit from some home comforts such as tea towels, curtains in 2nd bedroom, more glasses, safe etc. little things that make a difference
Location: it’s a very busy main road. You can walk to the Galata area or take a cheap taxi. There are some local restaurants but you’re better served in other districts or walking to Taksim area and down to Galata Tower.
Services: the gym is good and convenient and the pool looked nice. There is a decent cafe at lobby level which was convenient for breakfast.
Host: I can’t fault the responsiveness of the host. However, we had to call out for more things that you’d expect.
Value: we paid £1000 for a week between three of us which is amazing value.
Don’t hail yellow cabs they fleece you. Use Uber for great value fares.

We had a wonderful stay . Guest Teori was responsive to any questions. The place was in an ideal location to tourists attractions. The place was great and as described. We would definitely stay again. Thank you for hosting us

"Nice place to stay, safe, and well-maintained. The owner and the manager are very responsive, and the building staff are friendly. The location is excellent, close to Taksim and Nisantasi. The only issue we encountered was that the second room did not have an AC, which was not mentioned beforehand. They consider the portable AC as a fan, though we were promised a portable AC. Overall, it's a very good option in terms of location, and the owner, manager, and building staff were all great."
---

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Güvenilir ve çok tertemiz bir yerde ev sahibi de çok iyi birisi yani öneririm
The building staff was very polite, the place was cozy amd clean. Many restaurants are surrounding the building.
Vedat was kind and very helpful. Responded to our needs promptly. Overall good experience of Turkey.
guler yuzlu anlayisli hizmet. temiz guvenli konaklama. sicak samimi iletisim

Vedat bey çok yardimci oldu erkek arkadasimla beraber kaldik ev asiri tatliydi odada olmayan ihtiyaclarimizi da temin etti ev fotograflardaki gibiydi ve gayet temizdi kesinlikle tekrar geliriz ve öneririz

description:
This historic house is less than a 5-minute walk from Istiklal Avenue and offers endless opportunities to explore the city's most iconic streets and tourist attractions.
The apartment has been carefully renovated, very comfortable and elegantly decorated.
More than a hotel, our apartments provide a true home in the heart of the world's most exciting city, blending authenticity, freedom, attentive service and unwavering comfort.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described-clean, comfortable. The location was convenient and quiet, making it easy to relax while still being close to local attractions. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out seamless.

Perfect location, plenty of space and good amenities. Super easy check-in and check-out. There were only a couple of downsides — there was no hot water for one of two days, but then it was fixed by host. Also, there was a funky sewage smell in the bathroom, but it's a common thing for old Istanbul flats.

Great location—close to all the main spots, though the street is a bit uphill and can get a little noisy. The elevator was a bit tricky, but manageable. The host was very responsive—whenever we had questions or a hot water issue, they showed up within 10 minutes and fixed it right away. Overall, a solid stay!

The location was very walkable, with easy access to plenty of restaurants and shops, as well as Istiklal Street, Taksim Square, Galata Tower, and Galataport.
There are four small supermarkets on the street where you can buy basic necessities and fresh fruit.
However, the streets and neighborhood are very steep, which may not be suitable for elderly people. There are stairs at the entrance and also steps to access the elevator. The worst part was getting in and out of the elevator — it felt very unsafe and dangerous, especially for children and the elderly.
The four bedrooms were sufficient for 8 people. However, the kitchen lacked enough dinnerware and cutlery for that number. Additionally, there was no lounge area — just a dining table that seats six.
Overall, I personally was satisfied with the stay, but I would not recommend it for elderly guests due to the steep streets and unsafe elevator access.

Really nice place, highly recommended. Nice and clean rooms and beds, the master bedroom has a view of the Bosphorus as well. Host is responsive. The location is well connected, less than 10 minutes to T1 tram to the historic peninsula, and the same the other way to the metro.

description: You will be staying in the most active and lively environment by staying in this one-of-a-kind place.

reviews.text: When we booked the room, we expected the one that was in the pictures. The one in the pictures has a view of the water and was much larger than the one given to us. from the price that I paid, I expected that room. I am not sure if the price I paid was for the larger room and was given a smaller one. otherwise, the room given to us was very clean. The location is about a 15min walk to the main attractions. The hotel is located on top of a steep hill so keep that in mind if you're walking.

I really liked the place. The elevator was a great because most places Istanbul are like a hike to Macu Picu - if you're looking for a high floor with a view.
The apt, and building are newly built or refurbished. However, here are a couple shortcomings. Most importantly, the drain in the shower seems to be missing a watertrap meaning odors from the sewer seep back into the bathroom and room. Floors are a bit off level, giving a feeling that things will roll off into one corner. A pity because otherwise the place is like a lookout perch ... watching over the ships at see and the illuminated blue Mosqe at night.
The place was clean and everything I could've needed was provided incl slippers.
I would have welcomed some smaller lamp(s) or lights by the bedside. The dozen of so LED ceiling lights are like an X-ray at night.
The district is a few streets off the main trouist trail... but gives a bit of a more echt Istanbul feel, as you reside among small sewing shops and traders.

Situated in the centre of the city, all tourist spots were within walking distance . The room we stayed in, 501, had a great view, though was a bit smaller than it looks in the pictures. Our host Kadir was accommodating and was helpful with suggestions to commute to the airport.
The place was worth the money spent. I would recommend it to people looking forward to economically staying in proximity to the major tourists destinations.

We really enjoyed our stay at swans hotel! The most beautiful view, exactly as shown in the pictures. Prime location with restaurants at walking distance. Also very close to the main centre making it very easy to explore the city.
Hosts were also very friendly, hope to come back in the future

We had a wonderful stay at this new hotel. Everything was clean and brand new. The view of the Marmara Sea and the Blue Mosque was breathtaking! The room itself was cozy and comfortable, and all our needs were met. The host was incredibly accommodating and ensured we had a great experience. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a memorable stay in Istanbul.

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place.
Our apartment is located on the -1st floor.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The location was perfect close to everything, yet quiet enough to relax. The host was very kind and helpful. We’d definitely stay here again when visiting Istanbul!

Evin yeni olduğu çok belliydi, çarşaflar olsun havlular olsun tertemizdi. Mutfak malzemeleri, elektrikli aletler, çamaşır / bulaşık makinesi hep yeniydi, temizdi.. gönül rahatlığı ile kullandık.
Küçük detayları Mert Bey çok iyi düşünmüş, mesela giriş yaptığımızda evde suyun , ikramlık kahve/çay ın bulunması, deterjanların veya şampuanın olması gibi..
Ev belki küçük olabilir ama herşey düşünülmüş ve rahattı. 2 hafta 2 oğlumla rahat bir konaklama geçirdik.
Ayrıca araç otoparkı olması da büyük bir konfordu, dar ve yokuş olan sokaklara park etmek durumunda kalmadık.
Konum bizim için çok merkeziydi. TRT ulus binasına çok yakın bir konumda olup, araç ile rahatlıkla ana yollara bağlanabiliyorsunuz. Akmerkez, ortaköy merkez çok yakında. Ortaköy merkez yürüme ile 15 dk sürüyor, o da 1 yokuş olmasından kaynaklı...
Genel olarak tavsiye edebileceğim bir ev olup, ihtiyaç halinde tekrar seçeceğim.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Konum çok güzeldi gayet güvende hissettik fakat konumla ilgili tek eksi yön dik yokuşlar olabilir, bunun dışında gayet güzeldi. Mert Bey sorularımıza hızlı cevap verdi ve valiz bırakma konusunda esneklik sundu bu bakımdan çok rahat ettik. Evde lazım olabilecek pek çok şey bulunuyordu ve temizdi, güzel bir deneyim oldu. Bir sonraki seyahatimde tekrar tercih edebileceğim bir yerdi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.

Very clean apartment with modern design, has everything you need, special thanks for the steamer and washing powder. Highly recommend!

This unique place has a style all its own.
.

.
The apt in the 5 star luxury residence Sinpa queen bomotni that come will all 5 start hotel animation gym suna pools market in the lobby pharmacy coffe gardens tennis court bbq place and many others This unique.project aims to provide a high standard of living with easy access to city attractions and services

reviews.text: Lovely, spacious flat with fantastic views of Istanbul, the most comfortable furniture, and an impeccable host. In the lobby of the residence, you’ll find a great café with delicious food and coffee all day, a market that provides all your day-to-day needs, a salon if you need a haircut, and more. The gym and pool provide daily activity. Mobility is easy as taxis are always nearby, there’s an ATM a very short walk away, and you’ll feel safe and secure in a private, peaceful setting. If you’re looking for a place to relax and rest, this is it.
Great place to stay, spacious, comfortable with an amazing view. Host was very responsive and accommodated my requests. Would definitely stay here again.
Mr jamle was so helpful and ready to help and helped us a lot during our stay, Thank you again for being a great host.
As always another great stay.. Great host Great place
Excellent communication and room.

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text: The host is very friendly, helpful and quick response. The flat's location is very good, quiet neighborhood, walking distance to Taksim square and many nearby restaurants, cafes and shops. It's a neat and beautiful flat with private access to a small garden, quiet, nice furniture, with all necessary kitchenware for your stay. Wood floor, comfortable bed, it makes you feel like your own home. I highly recommend to all of you. will back soon.

The location is perfect. It was a bit chilly at night with just the radiator heating, but still able to sleep comfortably. No oven, as shown in photos. The garden was a nice retreat. Apartment is on 2nd floor and the steps are a bit difficult with luggage. Overall, it was a comfortable home in the heart of Istanbul.

Arya is a very responsive host, communication was very fast and clear. He solved the problem the same evening we arrived. The location of the apartment is incredibly ideal, near Jihangir with its many cafes, Taksim Square, etc. But the apartment itself is very old and renovated, and it looks much better in the photo than in real life.

The flat is as described and photos. The flat is simple with good basic facilities and a very beautiful back yard. The location is fantastic. Really central. And Anya’s communication was really good and quick.

Great location and a very peaceful area. Calm and nice. I slept very vell… the only thing that the place is a bit older than shown on the pictures. It’s dark during the day due to the lack of light. But for this price it’s amazing. I would definitely stay one more time!

description: As the Host, we care a lot about your comfort and satisfaction, so we make you feel at home by expanding and improving our homes more and more every day. You will have the greatest experience of all time in the most elegant neighborhood of Istanbul. The unique features of our home will blow your mind. We guarantee your 100% satisfaction with its excellent location, neighborhood and unique interior design. Experience perfect holiday moments.

reviews.text: I had a pleasant stay with my wife, place was clean and looked like the photos. There was a decent amount of pots and pans, cutlery etc. Migros and small markets are a short walk. Water is scalding hot, so be careful! Alanya is a small town and you can walk everywhere.

Bir-iki bize göre eksik dışında, fincan cezve, duş perdesi gibi(eleştiri değil, daha da iyileştirme amaçlı) her tşey on numaraydı.Evde 3 klima da faal durumda, sıcak su, buzdolabı, ocak, çamaşır, bulaşık makinası hepsi faal ve kaliteliydi bosch marka coğu. The place is well kept and a good size. Location is also great. Communication was amazing throughout the stay. Extremely friendly host. Definitely recommend staying here if you come to Alanya.
Ok, it could be better if change some old and broken furniture, but still good for this price. Great stores near.

description: A stylish and compact studio at the intersection of the heart of the city, history and energy. A location close to cultural wealth, entertainment, shopping and public transportation and in the center of Istanbul's iconic Beyoğlu district. The opportunity to explore the most beautiful spots of the city on foot; colorful streets, art-filled cafes, live music venues, boutiques, antique shops, independent stores and world cuisines. Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, Taksim Square, Karakoy, Galataport, Tersane Istanbul... all within walking distance.

reviews.text: A very comfortable place in Beyoglu. The property matched the description and the photos perfectly. The host was extremely helpful and allowed us an early check in as well. He is also very prompt in replying and all our questions were answered within minutes. There bus and ferry stops are at walking distance and there are many good restaurants, bakeries & cafes nearby. Another great feature is the presence of an elevator in the building. All in all , I would definitely recommend this place for your stay in Istanbul.

We enjoyed our stay in this flat. It is in a great location with nearby shops and food areas with great local prices. The flat is like in the photos. Transportation links are nearby. The sofa bed is also very comfortable! The host also communicated very well with us.

The host was very responsive and quick to help whenever needed. The nearest grocery store is easily accessible, and the bus stand is just a 5–6 minute walk away. The place was comfortable and clean, making it a pleasant stay. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again.

We had a nice 10 day stay. The location is in a safe and nice neighborhood. The apartment was like the photos and good for two people. The owner was fast to reply to questions, thanks.
The only slight negative was the shower wasn't cleaned at all when we arrived but wasn't a huge issue.

Konumu mükemmeldi her yere yakındık ve yorulmadan gezebilmene imkanına sahiptik . Fotoğraflarda gördüğünüz ne ise gittiğinizde onla karşılaşıyorsunuz. İhtiyacımız olabilecek her şey vardı . Sadece yerde saç ve kıl vardı o biraz rahatsız etti . Onun dışında temizlik konaklama vb her şey mükemmeldi . Fiyatını hak eden bir konaklama oldu .

description: This romantic place to stay offers a completely unique history.

reviews.text: The location and city view are great. However, there is no central heating in the building—you can only heat the room with the air conditioner, and the bathroom is freezing. The hot water was not working, and the bathroom light was broken. You can easily find other places that are at least as they are described.
Great host, great neighborhood with lots of Cafe and bars, nice view. But noisy at rush hours, hot water issues if you want a long bath.

Had a great stay - the location is very convenient, the room is nice and cozy, and the view from the window is magnificent. The host is helpful and responsive, too. The only thing is, the bathroom is tiny and there is no separation between shower and toilet space, but that’s more of a FYI and almost adds to the charm of the place. Otherwise, had a lovely stay - would recommend / stay again!

Great host, good location and close to nice local restaurants. Place was clean and host was responsive! Would definitely book here if I visited Istanbul again :)
Janka
Great place with great view,looked just like in the photos.Thanks for hosting. 100 percent would stay again!

description:
This studio located at perfect point that only one minute from Taxim Square. Location is center of Istanbul and it is compeletly safe and clean.
The Apartments renoveted and have all things that you need for personel comfort.
Managed by professionels like a hotel but you feel like at home

reviews.text:
Well the place from the start is very easily accessible and easy to find. Beautiful view from 2nd floor. However even though there was a lift as described, it was only after a flight of stairs. So you would have to carry your luggage up first then access the lift.
It does have plenty of kitchen amenities.
Some negatives about this apartment:
Water outage kept going in and out. At one point, we were without water for 5 hours. As the host communicated, the town was affected by the water outage as well.
There is black mold along the bathroom sink.
Bed is slumped inwards.
The water kettle is not clean along the spout, it is very easily missed.
Host also does not provide additional toilet paper or towels.
For the price that we paid, I believe this was an ok deal. This place would be good for maybe max 3 days stay. But we stayed for 5 days and ran out of toilet paper. Good for short stays and if you don’t have huge luggage.

We would like to sincerely thank the apartment owner for their kindness and professionalism. We initially rented the apartment for 6 nights through Airbnb, and because we liked it so much, we decided to extend our stay for an additional week. The apartment was very clean, well-organized, and comfortable, and the furniture was in excellent condition. Moreover, the location is very convenient and close to public transportation, which made getting around very easy. Everything was exactly as described, making our stay pleasant and stress-free. We highly recommend this apartment.

The place was super clean, affordable, and right in the heart of Taksim Square —shops, cafes, and metro all nearby. The host was awesome, quick to reply, and helped with my questions. Good value for money, would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a place in Taksim.

The suite need definitely a renovation specially the bathroom, the smell is really terrible , the location is fantastic but too much noise after midnight, no one say that there is one floor of a dangerous steps be for you reach the elevator , well that’s what you get when you pay less ,

My stay was not entirely satisfactory. The building exterior is very old and looks poorly maintained; as a young woman, I didn’t feel completely comfortable arriving there alone. The stairs and hallways are neglected and dirty, which made the place feel somewhat unsafe.
The room itself is very basic, with only the essentials. When I arrived, there was no toilet paper, which is a basic necessity. Although it was resolved the next day, I was initially told I could go buy it myself and be reimbursed, which I found inappropriate.
Additionally, one of the windows did not close properly, allowing a lot of street noise in. Since the area is very central, there is activity all night, making it difficult to sleep. The cold also came in through the window.
Overall, I was not satisfied with my stay.

description: Mall of Istanbul Shopping Mall, 212 Shopping Mall, public transportation are 5 minutes away. It is 30 minutes from Istanbul Airport, historical and tourist attractions. Services such as gym, indoor pool, outdoor pool, Turkish bath, sauna, steam room, massage are available for an extra fee.

reviews.text:
Airbnb's are supposed to be a home away from home experience, but there was no paper towel, no toilet paper, no dish soap, no cleaning products at all, no mop, curtains were so filty, no welcome bottle of water or fruits. One AC remote was missing so trying to put both units on was a pain. Heat didn't seem to work.
Looks nothing like pictures posted on Airbnb (very deceiving). Windows were so dirty. At checkin they want you to leave your passport so you can get the elevator access card until the end of your stay so basically they expect you to travel around a strange country without identification. The add claims the apartment sleeps 4, but it barely sleeps 2 because It's a full size bed and the couch isn't big enough to sleep on nor is it a pull out sleeper. Pots are not safe to cook in because the non stick coating has been all scratched up and super old. Knives are dull. No cutting board to cut fruits and vegetables on. They apartment lacks all necessities & needs an updo for cost.

We had a wonderful stay at Eda’s apartment from 14 May to 21 May. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. It had everything we needed for a relaxing 7-day stay, and the location was very convenient.
Eda was an excellent host — friendly, responsive, and always helpful whenever we had questions. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and we truly felt at home during our stay.
I would highly recommend staying here to anyone visiting the area, and I would happily stay again in the future. Thank you, Eda, for the great hospitality!
Eda was a great host. Place is clean and comfortable. Good value for money.

Eda's Place was spotless, nice and clean bedroom, very modern furniture with stylish kitchen. she is very responsive when it comes to your needs and questions, i loved staying here place and can't wiat to get back again soon. thanks for hosting me Eda

Host very friendly and fast to respond, the place nice modern, clean, safe and lovely, only problem we had is long walking to metro not his fault, and windows needed curtains,to get a good sleep, other then that the flat has all you need and modern clean stay. Thank you.

description: As the Semt İstanbul family, we welcome you, our valued guests, to our comfortable apartment on Karaköy Boğazkesen Caddesi, 150 meters from Galataport and 50 meters from the Tophane Tram. The apartment features 1 bedroom, a spacious living room, an open kitchen, and a bathroom. We offer a pleasant stay in a newly renovated building with an elevator, just a few steps from cafes and restaurants, in the heart of the city, and adjacent to historic areas. We would be happy to host you as the Neighborhood Istanbul family.

reviews.text:
Great location, 10 minutes walk to Galataport, 20 to 30 minutes for other areas. 5 minutes walk to transit, very accessible area.
The washing machine and dryer were a little complicated to figure out as they are in Turkish, and Google translate didn't exactly explainwell how to use the dryer. I gave the host some recommendations for new pillows, a new comforter was provided as the one I had was stained and they replaced it the next day. I suggested the replace the coffee maker as it was not worker and fix the shower hose that was leaking. The location is al9ng a busy street which can come with some noise but I always felt safe walking around this area no matter the time of day.

I had a very good experience staying at Fatih place. The apartment was clean and exactly same as described in the pictures.
The place is very close to public transport (Tram and Bus stops) to reach many first spots like Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, also Galata tower is at walking distance.
The Host is responsive and also helpful when you need something. He will try to help you as much as possible.
I won’t complain about the noise we hear at the streets because the whole Istanbul is similar.
One of the major advantage is that there is a grocery shop in front of the apartment building where you can also get ready to eat cut fruits , etc.
I would recommend this place. Also thank to Fatih for his great hosting.

Great place to stay! The best part is the location—the tram station is very close, with markets nearby as well. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. It was a little smaller than it looked in the photos, but perfectly comfortable for two people. Definitely recommended!

The apartment has a great location, literally walked down the street for the tram/Bus stations. Galataport was also just a 5 minute walk. It was a smaller space but just right for a single traveler or a couple. I felt safe walking in and out of the building on this street and in the area, which is super important for me so that was great. The apartment was also clean and had everything I needed for my 5 day stay. I’d definitely come back!

Great location! Many cute streets to discover nearby filled with cafes, restaurants, and shopping. Easy to walk to the street car and also take the ferry and metro. Nice place and just as pictured. Great communication from owner Fatih and excellent onsite manager Mrs. Katia who is onsite to help with anything you need. This place made our stay in Istanbul extra special - highly recommend!

description: Explore historic Istanbul from this modern 1-bedroom apartment, just steps from the sea. Perfectly located for sightseeing, it comfortably sleeps 4 guests. Enjoy a private retreat with AC in each room and walk to iconic landmarks like the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque in just 15 minutes. Your ideal base for discovering the city's heart.

reviews.text: Ev genel olarak fotoğraflardaki gibiydi; şık, temiz ve düzenliydi. Kumpapı Tren Durağı’na 2 dk, Kumkapı sahiline 5 dk mesafede oluşu ulaşımı oldukça kolaylaştırdı. T1 tramvay hattı da yakındı fakat yokuş yukarı olması nedeniyle valizle yürümek zorlayıcı olabilir. Havalimanından Havist’le Aksaray’a gelip 1.5 km yürüdük; ilk kez gelenler için yol biraz karışık olabilir ama merkezi konumu sayesinde çevreyi tanımak kolay. Salon kısmı rahattı; TV'den dijital platformlara erişebildik, klima iyi çalışıyordu. Yatak odasındaki klima ise yetersizdi. Pencere konumu ilk başta tedirgin edici olsa da güvenlik sorunu yaşamadık, gece rahat yürüyebildik. Merdivenler dik ve asansör yok, valiz taşımak zorlayıcıydı. Mutfak küçük ama işlevseldi. Banyodaki temizlik ürünleri ve kitler ince düşünülmüştü. İstanbul’da gece 00:00’dan sonra toplu taşıma sınırlı, bu saatte taksi ya da yürüyüş gerekebilir. Genel olarak keyifli ve sorunsuz bir konaklamaydı.

The apartment is located close to the sea, in a very good transport area close to tramway T6 which can bring you near the Grand bazar during 10 minutes (!) All the sightseeings are around 15-20 mins by walk. The street is calm (compaire to other streets where life never finishes ))) Sometimes in the evening you can hear nice turkish music from the restaurants nearby, but they finish at midnight. Take a notice that every morning at 6 o clock you will listen a prayer from the nearest mosque. This can not be avoided, as there are many mosques in Istambul, and this is a tradition for this place. With the time you get use to it and it even seems nice. So you start your day very early.
The apartment really looks as in the pictures. There are 2 bedrooms. We enjoyed our stay there, but there was some problem with the sewer that appeared just before our departure. Cengiz was very communicative and helpful, and promised to fix it. If he keeps his promises then I recommend this apartment.

I had a great stay at cengiz Airbnb. He was very friendly, welcoming, and easy to communicate with throughout my stay. The apartment looked exactly like the photos, honestly even more stunning in person. Everything was clean, comfortable, and well put together, The neighborhood was beautiful and had a great vibe, especially at night with plenty of nightlife and things to do nearby. I felt safe and really enjoyed exploring the area. Overall, I highly recommend staying here and would definitely come back again

The place was nice and quite clean, with everything needed for a comfortable stay.
The host was always available and helpful.
A great choice for the price.

Öncelikle burada discovery hotel yazıyor ama gittiğimde konuma tek başıma bulamazdım. Çevredekiler 18 numara dediğimde yardımcı oldu. Binada isim yok. description: You will find all kinds of shops and entertainment centers around you in the most popular area of Şişli, just a 3-minute walk from Osmanbey metro station, where you will be as comfortable as your home and stay safely and peacefully. Everything for transportation, shopping and relaxation will be waiting for you. We will be neighbors with you in our family building and will be happy to assist you with your requests at any time.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5
I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb apartment! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The bed was super cozy, and the Wi-Fi was strong, which was perfect for both relaxing and getting a bit of work done.
The location was excellent—close to local shops, restaurants, and public transport, yet in a quiet and safe neighborhood. It felt like a real home away from home.
Mr Erdem was incredibly welcoming and responsive, always available if I had any questions. Check-in was smooth, and I really appreciated the thoughtful touches around the apartment, like fresh towels, toiletries, and a guidebook with local recommendations.
I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Erdem is nice person and great host. He lives upstairs and is very responsive and supper helpful.
The apartment is in the great location, close to metro and buses, and walking distance to most tourist spots in the center. The place is very comfortable and very clean, equipped with all basics and even with cleaning supplies.
I highly recommend!

We have stayed in many different countries and in many different houses, but I can say that Erdem's house is the most successful in terms of cleanliness. The house is centrally located, within a 5-10 minute walking distance to the metro. It is well-heated, and the kitchen is equipped with all the basic tools you might need. The bed was very comfortable for us. Lastly, we had no issues during check-in or check-out, it was smooth and quick. If we need to stay in this area again, we will definitely choose Erdem's house.

All the reviews are true—Erdem is such a kind and welcoming host, and he really goes out of his way to make sure everything is perfect. The apartment is cozy, with a fully stocked kitchen, lots of storage, and thoughtful little touches that make it feel like a real home. We stayed for a week with our two small kids and it was super comfortable for a longer stay.
The neighborhood feels more local than Taksim or Sultanahmet, which we really enjoyed. It made groceries and meals out more affordable, but it was still lively and full of character. Just a 2-minute walk puts you right into the hustle and bustle of the city, and the metro is less than 10 minutes away—so getting around Istanbul was really easy.
We’re so glad we chose this place—thanks again, Erdem!

Erdem's apartment isn't fancy, but it is perfect. It is perfectly clean and comfortable. And it is perfectly located in a local neighborhood with lots of cafés, restaurants, and shopping. There's even a grocery store right across the street. The apartment is on the first floor of a small building with a lovely cross-breeze that keeps the apartment fresh and airy. The apartment is well laid out for a couple or single person, has an easy access entrance, and a washer AND dryer (a huge asset if you're planning more than a week in Istanbul). Erdem himself is a impeccable host. He helped me beyond the call of duty when I first arrived and answered every inquiry quickly and pleasantly. And the fact that he and his family live next door made me feel safe and relaxed. I would definitely stay there again.

description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, at the intersection of Taksim and Şişli, my hotel combines comfort and elegance. I offer my guests the opportunity to discover the hidden corners and prestigious stops of the city, providing care and comfort in every detail. Staying here is an experience that will make you feel at home while feeling the energy of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The location of the apartment was excellent and very convenient for exploring Istanbul. The flat looked exactly like the photos, and both check-in and check-out were easy and smooth. Overall, the apartment was clean and comfortable.
There were a few minor issues during our stay. The air conditioning did not work very well, and because there were no mosquito screens on the windows, we could not leave them open without getting many mosquitoes inside. Also, the TV was mainly decorative, as it was neither a smart TV nor connected to any TV channels.
Despite these small issues, we had a pleasant stay overall.

The place looks the same as the photos. The sofa was not so soft but it was fine. They forgot the cover for the sofa but the host was very responsive and delivered it immediately when we asked. The host replies very fast. The place is very clean and smells good. The Galata tower was very near, you can reach it by feet within a few mins. Going to Eminonu was easy from the place its only 15-20 mins walk or around 8mins to get to the cruise station. We check in as a family with a baby and we never had a problem (we apologise if there are some biscuits/food on the floor because of the baby, if theres a broom we would have cleaned it). Our only concern is there is no basic condiments or seasoning like salt, sugar and pepper. Also please leave a broom inside, thanks. Overall our experience with the place and host was satisfactory, we are very pleased. Thank you, Nazifcan 😊.

The host was not communicative and did not provide basic check-in details such as room number, floor, and Wi-Fi information (prior to check-in). I had to repeatedly ask for information and items throughout the stay.
The room was not so clean. There was visible dirt and dust on the floor, and the cooking hob were oily.
Many items were broken/damaged, indicating poor maintenance. The most unacceptable issue was the broken bidet valve, which is a basic facility. Although it was fixed the next day after I demanded a repair, this should never have happened.
The situation worsened when the air conditioner remote was taken without notice, claiming the general heater was on. The room became hot and uncomfortable, forcing me to open the window fully. Air conditioning is listed as an amenity, yet guests were denied control.
Despite all these issues, the host never apologized. Due to poor communication, cleanliness, misleading amenities, and lack of maintenance, I do not recommend this place.

This place is in need of maintenance and love, it's falling apart. It also was dirty when we arrived with hair in the bathroom, scummy dishes in the cupboard, and dust/dirt everywhere. no cleaning products were provided either, so we couldn't clean the place, this includes dish soap and sponges. We also only got one body towel and one hand towel for the entire apartment for 2 people over 5 nights, which sucked. There is a washing machine that works, but no rack for drying. The hot water heater was fixed at 35 degrees so we only got warm showers.
things look like they do in the photos but this place hasn't been maintained for a long time and is not comfortable or relaxing. The couch and matching blue pillows on the bed were grimey and mungey.

This was my second time staying here, and once again, everything was perfect! The house is beautiful, clean, comfortable, and especially located in the heart of the city. The location is excellent and very convenient for exploring everything around. The host is always welcoming and helpful. We truly enjoyed my stay again and would definitely come back. Highly recommended! ❤️

reviews.text:
I stayed at this Airbnb for two weeks during my third visit to Istanbul, and it was a great experience. Everything was exactly as described, the apartment had everything I needed, and it was very clean upon arrival.
Mr. Murat was an excellent host. He was easy to communicate with, responded quickly to messages, and was always helpful.
The location is also very convenient. There's a BIM just a 3-minute walk away, a Carrefour Express about 5 minutes away, and the Metrobus is only a 5–8 minute walk. It's also close to the ferry terminal, bus station, and metro, making it easy to get around the city.
Overall, I was very satisfied with my stay. It offers excellent value for the price, and I would definitely book with Mr. Murat again.

I would unhesitatingly recommend this place. It is a small and cosy studio with a compact but comfortable bathroom. Hosts were always responsive. Due to no error and out of the hosts’ control (due to a prior weather event), the elevator in the building ended up not working for almost the entire time we were there (it only started working on the 3rd night of our 3 night stay). But the host organized to have someone take our luggage to the 5th floor on the stairs. Although the walking up was an inconvenience during our stay, the host did everything they could, including compensating us reasonably for the failure of an amenity. By the time we left, the elevator was functioning again. Despite the inconvenience which was out of the control of anyone, the way the hosts handled the situation makes me sure that I would take any place from these hosts again. They also shared some recommendations when we requested. We could only do one of those recommended restaurants, but it was phenomenal!

reviews.text:
The place was clean, cozy, and even more tidy and bright than the photos showed.
What truly stood out was the heating system – it kept the entire space perfectly warm during the cold winter days, which made our stay extremely comfortable.
The host was exceptionally kind and welcoming, always ready to help with anything we needed. Responses were quick and thoughtful, and they went above and beyond to make sure we had everything for a smooth and pleasant stay.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for a spotless, warm, and friendly home away from home!

Sürekli tercih ettiğim temiz, düzenli, rahat ve güvenli bir konaklama yeri. Konum olarak güzel yakınında avm bulunuyor ve güzel bir semtte. Emre bey gerçekten çok ilgili mesajlara anında dönen her konuda bilgi veren aynı zamanda her konuda yardımcı olan müthiş bir ev sahibi. Her şey için teşekkürler.

Ev oldukça merkezi, hemen karşısında otobüs durağı var bu sayede Söğütlü çeşmeden tek araçla ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Giriş-çıkış sırasında ev sahibi sizi oldukça detaylı şekilde yönlendiriyor. Biz gideceğimiz etkinlik mekanına yürüme mesafesi olması nedeniyle tercih ettik, iyi ki de burada konaklamışız çok rahat, temiz ve düzenliydi. Ev sahibi daha siz eve girmeden ihtiyacınız olabilecek her şeyle ilgili sizi bilgilendiriyor ve sizinle konaklama süreniz boyunca olur da bir şeye ihtiyacınız olursa diye iletişimde kalıyor. Her şeyiyle çok iyi bir deneyimdi, aynı bölgede konaklamamız gerekirse asla macera aramayız. Ev sahibi Emre Bey'e her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz.

Konaklamamız her yönüyle mükemmeldi. Evin olanakları fazlasıyla yeterliydi, konumu ise her yere yakın ve son derece avantajlıydı. Temizlik konusunda beklentilerimizin üzerindeydi, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi tertemiz ve düzenliydi. Ev sahibi de her an ulaşılabilir, ilgili ve yardımseverdi.

Gerçekten çok güzel bir konaklama geçirdik. Ev tertemiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Ev sahibimiz Emre Bey çok nazik ve yardımcıydı, her konuda destek oldu; saat konusunda hiçbir problem yasamadık çok ilgiliydi tekrardan teşekkür ediyoruz 🙏Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. reviews.text: Clean, comfortable, and as described. The host was responsive and helpful. **Superb location—just steps from Istiklal and Taksim Square!** Fast, reliable Wi-Fi too. Highly recommend.

I had a great stay at Hasan’s place. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is very convenient and close to everything.
Hasan is a kind and responsive host, and communication was always easy.
Everything was great, and I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

The flat is a budget friendly option and has most of the basic facilities you’d need for a short stay. However, there are a few things to keep in mind before booking. The apartment is located on the second floor with no lift, and the street leading to it is on a steep hill, which might not be ideal for elderly guests or anyone with mobility or knee issues. The area is quite lively and can be noisy at times, especially due to the café downstairs that plays music from morning until late at night. So if you’re sensitive to noise, this might be something to consider.
That said, Hasan is a great host very responsive and always ready to help and solve any issues quickly, which I truly appreciated during my stay. Overall, this isn’t the cheapest option available.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this fully renovated 2-bedroom apartment, located just a short walk from Taksim Square. The building is new, with an elevator and air conditioning in every room — a rare find in Istanbul! Everything was clean, modern, and exactly as described.
We were only the second guests to stay here, and it already feels like a top-tier Airbnb. The location is excellent, with a supermarket right in front of the building and plenty of restaurants and shops nearby.
The host was incredibly kind and helpful throughout our stay. He provided everything we needed and even helped us carry and load our luggage into the van when we left — truly above and beyond.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located, and host-supported stay in Istanbul. We would gladly come back!

Ismet was a great host and I would definitely recommend this building to friends. The units are modern and clean. We stayed in two of the units for almost two weeks and were very comfortable. The 3 br unit is on the ground floor and has a half bath and full bath downstairs with the bedrooms, and kitchen upstairs, so you have to go down to use the bathroom. The upper units are all accessible by elevator which is convenient and rare for this area. 10 min walk to İstiklal street. There are loads of great coffee shops and restaurants nearby and a Migros grocery shop right across the street. If you need anything the host is quick to reply. Our favorite places we ate at were Persian food at Reyhun and Termeh, a 15 min walk.

We stayed at Miray’s place for over three weeks and really enjoyed it. The apartment is newly renovated, very comfortable, and in the quiet yet trendy Cihangir neighborhood. It’s hard to imagine a more convenient spot—just a short walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, with plenty of cafes, restaurants, and antique shops nearby. The apartment has everything needed for a longer stay, including a washing machine, stove, and AC in every room. It was also very well cleaned before our arrival. The building has two doors with keypads, and someone managing the property is always downstairs, which makes it very secure and ensures help is available if needed, though we never had issues. The space is bright, clean, and thoughtfully furnished, quickly feeling like home. Miray is a great host—friendly, attentive, and quick to respond. We truly appreciated the hospitality and smooth communication and would definitely try to stay here again on our next visit to Istanbul.

The apartment was beautiful, spotless, spacious (4 adults) and super confortable. I felt right at home. The bedrooms are in the back of the apartment and there are blindfolds in the windows so you can rest without the noise and lights from the street... it feels very warm and cozy. The kitchen is equipped with the basics to cook light meals.
Having an elevator available to bring our baggage upstairs was very convenient. The location is great! Close to many cute coffee shops and restaurants. Walking distance to many cultural attractions without being overwhelmed by the crowds.
Communication with Miray was efficient, clear and respectful. He was very helpful to recommend local places, and to respond to our needs. We had an early morning flight and he allowed us to check in a bit earlier. I fully recommend this place!

I really want to thank Miray for his great hospitality and amazing apartment. Everything was good clean and brand new. The location is amazing with noce coffees just down the building. Several mins walking to taksim metro station and istiklal road without slope. And there is elevator and ACs in all the rooms.
The most important thing is the host, Miray is always responding and he kept checking on us if we need anything with a really kind smile.
In our next visit for sure will stay here

We where a group of friends visiting and it was the perfect place to hang around Kadiköy. Not only that but also the ferry to Karaköy/Eminünü is only a 5 Minute walk from the Air BnB so you are in the center of Istanbul in 30 Minutes.
We arrived at SAW airport and the Metro took us directly to the Air BnB which is also very comfortable.
Communication with the host is very easy as there is someone localy available all the time. Also great to have enough keys to split into different groups.
The flat generaly has a nice vibe and the furniture is good quality and beds are comfortable.
All in all we where very happy with our stay.

The flat was comfortable and had everything we needed. It is very close to a whole host of restaurants and tourist spots and an easy walk from the ferry if you want to go see some of the more traditional sights. The street is full of lovely food shops and restaurants making it an interesting and very busy place. We could sometimes hear the football game from the pub next door and some of the noise from the street (not a problem unless you're noise sensitive), but the noise was usually over by midnight at the latest. Cross over the tramline and you get to some less touristy neighbourhoods, with lovely art studios and loads of great vintage shops. A great base for exploring the city. We loved our stay here.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Evin konumu gerçekten mükemmeldi; hem eve ulaşım hem de İstanbul’u gezmek için çok merkezi bir noktadaydı. Çarşının merkezinde olduğu için etrafta birçok restoran, bar ve eğlence mekânı bulunuyordu.
Ev oldukça temizdi, eşyalar yeni ve bakımlıydı. İhtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey düşünülmüştü. Girişte bizi çok sıcak bir şekilde karşıladılar ve tüm süreç oldukça rahat geçti. İstanbul’da konforlu ve keyifli bir konaklama yapmak isteyen herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

“The apartment was absolutely wonderful and exceeded our expectations. It was spotless and very well organized. The location is perfect; surrounded by many great restaurants, cafes, and bars. It’s also very convenient for transportation, just a few minutes’ walk to the metro and ferry pier. The apartment has been beautifully restored with modern touches, and every detail has been carefully considered. The decoration is warm and tasteful, which made us feel right at home. The host was very attentive and welcoming. It was the best choice for our stay in Istanbul and we would definitely recommend it.”

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
It’s ok if you’re not picky
Good things i experienced:
- helpful host
- location
Bad things:
- ants
- skid marks in the toilet
- stink and buildup in the washing machine
- no hot water
- loud noises from the boiler
The noises from the boiler disturbed my sleep the first night. I addressed all the problems to the host the second day and he came with the cleaning lady to cleanup my room and show how to deal with the boiler.
It turned out the gas was cut off in the room which means no boiler and no hot water.
The host told me he’ll talk to the gas people why it happened but i showered in cold water all my 6 days, which was not good.

Besher was friendly but failed to inform us in advance that the boiler for the shower and heating frequently cuts out. I was in the middle of a shower when the water went cold and he answered 3 hours later with prerecorded instructions on how to fix it, which I wish he had sent as part of the welcome pack or something.
The room is spacious and beautiful but the boiler makes loud noises throughout the night.
Also the refrigerator didn’t work at all once plugged in, but we just put our food on a cold window sill and it was ok. I didn’t bother to write the host about the refrigerator, I just wanted to focus on enjoying my stay.
Great location.

Everything was good. I easily found the house. The apartment was just like in photos. Make sure you get the boiler instruction for hot water. Thank you so much for your wonderful place. It s just near the pier but it’s quiete. So the location is perfect

Great location near Galata tower. Lots of restaurants and easy to walk to attractions/take public transport. When I arrived there were a few ants but they were gone the next day. Also some stains on the bed coverings. Otherwise the place was a good size and decently clean.

We had a really good stay in this apartment. The location is so good, it’s easy to reach every part of Istanbul from it.
The apartment is not new and it shows but it doesn’t have any big problems whatsoever. It’s perfect for a short stay.
The host is very easygoing, friendly and tries his best to make you feel comfortable and welcomed.

description:
We offer you a great apartment with best view of old town at the heart of old peninsula, comfortable double bedrooms, a bathroom with washing machine and dryer. A large kitchen fully equipped for cooking. A terrace and more.
House is located in quite hotels street.
I am living in the same building and my guests can reach me 7/24

reviews.text: The apartment is spotless and lovely. All the rooms were big, and the beds were comfortable; the bathroom was clean, the shower had plentiful hot water. You are an 5 minutes walk away from the historic center of the city. The view is better than any picture can show. Mahmoud was friendly and very helpful. Be aware: there are several flights of circular stairs. This was one of the nicest Air B & B’s I’ve stayed in. I would love to stay here again and highly recommend it.

I had a wonderful 5-night stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The space was exceptionally clean and very comfortable. The view was beautiful and truly enhanced our experience. The location was also very convenient, making it easy to get around and explore the city.
Mahmud was a fantastic host—responsive, and welcoming. He kindly left some food in the refrigerator and also helped us with our luggage, which we really appreciated.
One thing to note is that the apartment is located up four flights of stairs with no elevator, which was challenging for both me and my mom and especially after long days out. This may be important for guests with mobility concerns.
Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend it for its view, cleanliness, location, and excellent host.

Mahmud’s place is in a great location, a short walk from all of Sultanahmet’s great tourist attractions. The apartment itself is spotlessly clean and comfortable, with a fabulous view over the Sea of Marmara and the Bosphorus. Mahmud is a friendly and responsive host, who welcomed us on arrival and helped carry our luggage up the four flights of stairs to the apartment. (You’ve got to earn that view.) He had some helpful suggestions about dining out during our stay and he arranged a taxi to the airport when we left and helped carry our luggage back down. The apartment is thoughtfully provisioned, e.g., with a “starter pack” of food and laundry detergent. The four flights of stairs would be difficult to manage if you’re mobility-impaired, but otherwise we highly recommend Mahmud’s place.

We had a wonderful stay at this property! The house itself is beautiful, clean, and comfortable, and the location is absolutely perfect for exploring and better than expected. Unfortunately, during our stay, the glass shower door spontaneously shattered due to structural stress while being closed. The hosts were incredibly accommodating, understanding, and responsive. They came over immediately to help us clean up the glass and ensure we were safe.They handled an unpredictable event with extreme grace and professionalism. Highly recommend staying with such helpful and kind hosts. Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay in Istanbul. The apartment was in a safe and excellent location, just a short walk from Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. We could not have asked for a better base for exploring the city.
The apartment was on the fifth floor, exactly what we wanted. Because the building faces both east and west, we enjoyed beautiful panoramic views of Istanbul throughout the day.
Our host, Muhmad, was welcoming and very helpful. We arrived late at night during a holiday, and our trip took longer than expected. Knowing we would arrive tired, he thoughtfully left breakfast items and essentials for us. It was a wonderful surprise and made our first morning much easier.
Muhmad also provided great recommendations for restaurants, local foods, and places to visit, and was always available when we had questions.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended!

description:
This room, which offers a comfortable and practical stay for exploring the city, has 1 single bed. Our room is suitable for 1 guest.

Your room features air conditioning, Wi-Fi, a TV, a mini fridge and an electric kettle. We also offer complimentary tea and coffee.

There is a private bathroom, shower and toilet for our guest's use inside the room.

reviews.text: Room looks exactly as advertised, place was nice for one person, has all amenities described and a nice host!

There were many mosquitoes I couldn't even sleep but the hosts provided repellent. room was fine, weird to have the shower in the same bathroom and not separately but was just ok. Very tiny hand washer. Weird check-in time at 11pm but fast responding.
Responsive and helpful host.

This place is nothing fancy, but perfect for the price. I just needed a place to sleep. The staff was really friendly, as they carried my luggage up and down the stairs and lent me a phone charger. Thank you!

I got no check-in info at all, and the host’s profile was basically empty. When I asked what was going on, the host got weirdly aggressive and accusatory. I couldn’t even stay there, and they still refused to give a refund. This is definitely not a real Airbnb — I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

Everything was as expected.
The host was really kind and helpful.

description:
A new living space in Maslak 1453...
Apartment options from 1+0 to 3+1 with new furnishings...

24-hour reception and security.
Daily housekeeping service.
Free gym, sauna, and steam room.
Indoor parking.

The Maslak 1453 complex offers a variety of dining options and opportunities for enjoyable relaxation.
Four markets and shopping outlets allow you to meet all your needs without leaving the complex.
Enjoy your stay.

reviews.text: It was my third time staying at this hotel. Staff is helpful, rooms are clean, location is great. The host was very responsive and ready to help out.

Daireye girdiğimizde zemin tozlu ve saç kılları vardı.Balkon kirliydi. Onun dışında her şey iyiydi. Banyo çok temizdi. Yatak çarşafları tertemizdi. Dairede sigara içilmesi serbest olmasına rağmen hiç sigara kokmuyordu. Mutfak araç gereçleri temizdi. Günlük havlu değişimi ve çöpleri almaları çok iyiydi. Sessiz huzurlu ve konforluydu. Zemin temizliği dışında çok memnun kaldık.
Comfortable place would recommend
Güzel bir evdi.Sadece banyoda duşakabin bölmesi olmaması kötüydü.Tavsiye ederim
Gayet güzel ve yeterli

description: We are Tsn for Property Mngmt company with over 45 apts in our portfolio. Our 1 Br apt is located in Boğazkesen street, Galata. Located in third floor, 250 meters away from Galata Port w/ easy access to all attractions and hip restaurants & cafes in its neighbourhood. The apt is 90 sqm and well designed for our guests needs: 2 AC, 1 bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchen with all appliances and utilities, a small living room, ULTRA FAST wifi. We look forward to hosting you here

reviews.text: The location is excellent, but unfortunately the apartment does not match the listing photos or its price. The photos appear to have been taken when the apartment was newly renovated. In reality, it is much more worn, with cracks on the walls and old furniture. The biggest issue was the living room air conditioner, which never worked. I reported it on the first day, but after initially ignoring my message, the host only said the service company was busy. Nothing was fixed during our stay. The only TV also didn’t work, and although the host said they would come to check it, nobody came. We also found only one mug on arrival. Additional mugs were delivered two days later, and one was chipped.
