The airport transfer is overpriced compared to local taxis, uses old vehicles, requires cash, and cancellation fees were not clearly explained in advance. Great location, but because of the apartment’s condition and the lack of maintenance, I would not stay here again.

The location is good and the host is responsive.
However, the apartment was smaller than expected and could benefit from some cosmetic renovation. Cleanliness was below expectations: the bathroom and balconies were not very clean, which made the outdoor space unpleasant to use.
The kitchen was minimally equipped, with very few dishes and no cutting board, dishwashing sponge, or even basic essentials like salt.
Overall, the stay was okay, but the apartment did not fully match our expectations.
Amazing stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything went smoothly, and I’d definitely stay here again.
Had a great stay, apartment as described and in a good location.

It was our first trip to Istanbul and this location was a perfect place to stay in the Taksim area. The neighborhood was so peaceful and the home was comfortable. Would recommend to stay if you’re looking for a great location with your spouse.

description: Our fully renovated deluxe 2-bedroom apartment is on 2 floors and has no elevator. The apartment is fully furnished and suitable for 7 people and cooking. World-famous Taksim Square, Istiklal Avenue, public transportation points, 500 meters from the subway. You can also find all the equipment such as hair dryer, 2 x TVs, heater, 2 x air conditioners, internet, dishwasher, washing machine, vacuum cleaner, iron, kitchen utensils, cooking, pan, pot, blender, toaster, glasses, oil, sugar, tea, coffee.

reviews.text: I had a great stay at this Airbnb. The property was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. Check-in was easy, and the host was friendly and responsive. The location was convenient and made it easy to get around. I would happily stay here again and recommend it to others.

The host is very friendly and cooperative. The apartment is as described. It could have been cleaner (dirt and insects under the beds and in the staircase) and larger, especially when promissing to accomodate up to 7 people. The ladies who clean and service the apartments can't care less. Perhaps most annoying was that other guests were very loud, partying the whole night.

Konaklamamız boyunca her şey harikaydı. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi. Konumu da oldukça rahattı. Ev sahibinin ilgisi ve iletişimi çok nazikti, her konuda yardımcı oldu. Gözüm kapalı tekrar tercih edebileceğim ve gönül rahatlığıyla herkese önerebileceğim bir yer.

Mükemmel bir konumda fiyat performans olarak düşünmeniz lazım
ev 1artı 1 odanın birinde 1 çift kişilik yatak 1 tek kişilik yatak 1de altlı üstlü çift kişilik ranza var diğer odada ise 1 çift kişilik yatak mevcut toplaamda 7kişi konaklayabilir
teşekkürler hasan

Konum, fiyat ve ev düzeni kusursuzdu. Sadece temizlik konusunda yastıklar çok temiz değildi o yüzden 4 verdim ama bu konuyu onlara bildirmeme gerek kalmadan çözebilmiştim. Eminim söylediğiniz yardımcı olacaklardır.

description: Modern minimalist 3BR apartment on a quiet street in Moda, Kadıköy. Features 3 double bedrooms, a cozy living room, open-plan kitchen, 2 bathrooms, and a large terrace with Kadıköy city views. Fully equipped with high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, vacuum, full kitchenware, elevator, and all essentials. Just 15 minutes to metro, ferry, and public transport—ideal for families, groups, or remote work stays.

reviews.text:
Location: Praised as ideal.
Apartment: Described as clean, spacious, bright, and accurately depicted in photos. Highlights include a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bed, modern bathroom, and a pleasant terrace.
Host: The host is commended for exceptional hospitality, clear communication.
Overall: Considered excellent value, feeling like a "home away from home" that surpasses a hotel stay. The reviewer strongly recommends it and plans to return.
Rating: A perfect 5/5 stars.

We stayed in this apartment as a family of four and had a very comfortable experience. The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos—clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully equipped.
Each room has its own air conditioning unit with both cooling and heating functions, which made our stay pleasant in all conditions.
The host was exceptionally responsive, replying within minutes to any question we had, and kindly helped us arrange a taxi to the airport.
The location is very convenient: there is a small supermarket in the same building with everything you might need. Within a 10-minute walk, you can reach the Marmara Sea promenade, which is perfect for a relaxing stroll - you can walk to a lovely library-café for a coffee. The Kadıköy ferry terminal is about a 20-minute walk away, making it easy to reach the European side of Istanbul.
There are also many nice cafés and restaurants in the area.
Highly recommended!

Well organized, well equipped apartment in a good location. Berk and friends are very kind and helpful hosts, all of them speak good English. Entry is easy, and luckily there is a lift which is a bonus since the apartment is on the 6th floor.
I have only minor observations: the apartment is very humid, and the terrace needs some kind of sunshade, otherwise it's totally useless during the hot months of the year. The bathrooms' ventilation is poor and there is not a hook or a shelf or anything to put or hang your staff (towel, clothes, glasses, toiletries, etc.) on. The shower stall is leaking a bit in the bigger bathroom.
Overall this is a good accomodation, although a bit overpriced, I still recommend it for bigger groups or families!

Spent 4 nights at Berk’s place. Neat and clean property which is quite spacious and comfortably furnished. Location is very convenient. Hosts were extremely responsive within minutes. One of them , Ibrahim was literally at our beck and call. They apparently have an office in the building. A few observations about the property though. Bathrooms have virtually no counter space . A strategically placed shelf could make it more functional. Also, a microwave oven in the kitchen would be really nice. All in all, very comfortable stay. Would not hesitate to visit again.

Evde kaldığımız süre boyunca her şeyden çok memnun kaldık. Eve ilk girdiğimiz andan itibaren temizliği, düzeni ve sıcak atmosferi insanı gerçekten rahatlatıyor. Fotoğraflarda gördüğümüzden bile daha güzel ve özenliydi.
Evde ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her detay düşünülmüş; konaklama boyunca kendimizi misafir gibi değil, kendi evimizde gibi hissettik 🏡
Ev sahibiyle iletişimimiz çok nazik ve sorunsuzdu. Aynı şekilde süreç boyunca yardımcı olan herkes de oldukça ilgili, güler yüzlü ve çözüm odaklıydı. Bu ilgi ve düzen, konaklamayı bizim için çok daha huzurlu hale getirdi.
Konumu, sessizliği ve genel düzeni sayesinde keyifli ve rahat bir konaklama geçirdik. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederiz. Tekrar bu bölgeye yolumuz düşerse, hiç düşünmeden yeniden tercih edeceğimiz bir ev olur ⭐️

description: Our apartment is on the 2nd floor. The rooms have an electric stove, kitchen utensils, Smart TV, air conditioning and a heater. It is centrally located within a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Avenue.

reviews.text: Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The location is excellent, and the host is very responsive and helpful with any requests or questions. One thing to keep in mind is that the space feels a bit smaller in person than it appears in the photos, especially the bathroom, which is quite small. Other than that, it’s a nice place in a great location.

Arkadaş grubu olarak konakladık ve mennun kaldık. Binaya giriş-çıkış çok kolaydı. Extra kolaylıklar sağlandı...
Wifi harika, modemin odanın içerisinde olması sinyal kalitesinin %100 olmasını sağlıyor. Android Tv var ve Çalışıyordu.
Mutfak biraz ufak ama kısa süreli konaklamalarda gayet yeterli. Tava, tencere ve kaşık-çatal mevcut. Bölge güvenlik konusunda sıkıntılı değil, ana caddeye ve polislere yakın. Odanın boyası yeni, temiz ve ferah. Tek sorun pencereler, dışarıdan fazla ses gelmesi oldu, başka hiç bir sorun yaşamadık. Ayrıca gardolabında yeteri kadar askılık vardı. Yaz mevsimi olduğu için fazla duş almak zorunda kaldık bunun için fazladan havlu istedik ve hemen tedarik ettiler. İhtiyaçlarınız konusunda irtibata geçtiğinizde ilgili ve alakalı bir ev sahibi.
It is a great place for its price! The location is very nice, and the host is very responsive and friendly

Gayet temizde istaklal caddesine de yakındı
22:30 dan önce gelmeye çalışın biraz kapıda bekledik ama mağdur olmadık güler yüzlü kibar biriydi ev de fotoğraflarda ki gibi gayet temiz hijyenik memnun kaldık

Konaklamaya gittigimizde oda hala temizlenmemisti ve de 1 saat beklememizi istediler biz de bekledik sonra girdigimizde sigara paketi ilac kutusu gibi copler vardi cikis yaparken 1 saat gec girdigimiz icin 1 saat gec cikmamiz gerektigini soyledik kabul edilmedi adaletsiz oldugunu dusunuyorum konum iyi👍

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Abdulkadir was a great host to us , very communicative and answering our requests very quickly , he was helpful and friendly,
The room was very clean , and had all important amenities, very close to taksim , any 10 min walk
The room had ac which was very useful in the heat, he got us all what we asked for ,
Check in and check out was very smooth,
The beds were super comfortable , we would definitely be staying with him next time , I highly recommend his place and services,
We had a wonderful time, also taxi and uber can collect you and drop you right at the door ,
Truly a pleasure first stay in Istanbul,😇❤️

Perfect place for a short stay! The host is very proactive, communicates really well and very helpful. The room I was originally given had a problem with the shower. The host promptly address it and moved me to a different room. I would highly recommend
Nice and clean place, very friendly and responsive host.
Host was very kind, helpful, and trustworthy. I would recommend.

Die Unterkunft ist genau wie auf den Fotos. Der Check-In und Check-Out war total unkompliziert und der Gastgeber stets gut zu erreichen. Die Lage ist super zentral an Taksim gelegen und ebenfalls für alle weitere Verbindungen. Klare Empfehlung! 😊

description: Within walking distance to Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace and many historical places

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay. The place was clean, comfortable and as described. Hikmet was a kind and responsive host.
Just a small note for guests, the property has stairs only and the staircase is quite narrow. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend it.

Hikmet’s place is exactly as described and the location is perfect. It is just a few hundred meters from the Blue Mosque. There are plenty of restaurants and late-night shops nearby, making everything very convenient. While public transport is easily accessible, we opted for taxis and Uber due to the rain.
Check-in instructions were clear and simple, and Hikmet himself is incredibly kind and easy to communicate with. We unfortunately had a slightly late check-out because my phone died (forgot to charge it!) and I lost track of time; I offered to pay for the extra time, but Hikmet graciously declined. We truly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place!

Honestly, as first timers, this place was everything during our stay in Istanbul. Located right in the pulsating, historic heart of the city, all major landmarks were within easy reach.
Hikmet’s apartment was super clean, very well organized, and wonderfully comfortable after long days of exploring the city. Hikmet was a fantastic host, attentive, friendly, and always quick to answer questions.
The neighborhood is posh and quiet at night, which makes it a perfect location for family trips. Highly recommended for those who are into history and visiting the city for the first time.
This place is in walkable distance to major tourist destinations. The Airbnb was exactly as it was described on the listing. The host is very responsive.

Overall the apartment and its location is great, close to local markets and the Blue Mosque. Marked down one star due to tight staircase which would make hauling heavy luggage difficult. Also, the toilet and shower room were very small but clean overall. Will stay again due to excellent location.

description: Experience the heart of Istanbul at our 19-room boutique hotel. Located 4 minutes from Marmaray Aksaray and T1 Tram, we are 7 minutes from the Blue Mosque and 10 minutes from the Grand Bazaar. Enjoy an authentic breakfast featuring traditional homemade borek with a mother's touch. Reach Istanbul Airport in 90 minutes via Marmaray. Galata Bridge is only 12 minutes away. Perfect for city explorers seeking comfort. Contact us now for airport transfer services and our best rates.

reviews.text: Hosts are marvelous, giving a sense of home and surprising breakfast! I accidentally tainted the bed sheet with my pen but the host didn’t charge me for cleaning. thanks again! The hotel boasts a great location surrounded by Metro, Tram and Bus stations meaning you can go anywhere without confusing how to access the public trans. If you enjoy walking it also takes you only about 15min to get to the major attractions.

Perfect place for a couple of days staying in fatih ,
The room was spotless and clean, the reception
Was helpful and friendly, totally worth the stay , would come back again.
Metroya yakın temizdi biz arkadaşımla memnub kaldık ama havalandırmadan çok ses geliyordu o biraz rahatsız etti sadece
Very nice place. Clean, Comfy, even the elevator looked really nice. Its really close to the Yenikapı Metro station So thats A plus too. The stay was not bad, would recommend.
Konaklama süperdi,oda temiz ve düzenliydi. Fotoğraflardakinin de aynısıydı biz çok beğendik.Odalarda bardak ta bulunsa tadından yenmez,teşekkürler😁

description:
Hello friends!
Home is in the heart of the city, at the same time in a safe and tourisric neighborhood, side Nisantasi.
City's Mall 5 minutes on foot.
Osmanbey Metro Stop and bus stops are only a 30 seconds by walking.
Taksim and Galata are just one stops by metro.
You can go to the Anatolian side in just 25-30 minutes by metrobus.
Have a fun day!

reviews.text: Ev gerçekten beklediğimizden çok çok daha iyiydi. Fotoğraflarda güzel görünüyordu ama gerçekte çok daha ferah, çok daha temiz ve çok özenliydi. Her şey pırıl pırıldı ve evde ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şey düşünülmüştü. Mutfak ekipmanlarından banyodaki detaylara kadar tüm olanaklar eksiksizdi. Konumu da çok iyi ve her yere yakındı. Konaklamamız boyunca kendimizi gerçekten evimizde hissettik. Tekrar gelsek hiç düşünmeden yine burada kalırız. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

My son and I had a wonderful stay at Victor’s apartment in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and truly felt like a home away from home.
What made our stay especially meaningful was Victor himself. My son and I were both post-op patients during our stay, and Victor went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable, cared for, and at home. He was incredibly kind, attentive, and responsive whenever we needed anything.
When we realized we needed adapters for our chargers, Victor even went out of his way to get them for us. It was thoughtful gestures like this that made such a difference, especially while we were both recovering.
We felt genuinely taken care of throughout our stay, and we are so grateful for Victor’s kindness and hospitality. I would absolutely recommend Victor and his apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you, Victor, for making a challenging time away from home feel so much easier and more comfortable. ❤️

Hello,
First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for your kindness, understanding, and great cooperation.
Your warm welcome and hospitality were truly appreciated.
The accommodation was very comfortable, well-organized, and provided all the services we needed.
Also, the location was excellent, with everything nearby, especially the easy access to transportation, with several stations just a few minutes’ walk away.
Thank you again for everything, it was truly a wonderful experience staying with you.
We hope to see you again soon 🤍

Great stay in this apartment in Şişli! The location is fantastic, one of the best areas in Istanbul, and just a short walk to the metro station, making it super easy to get around the city.
The apartment itself was very clean, spacious, and comfortable, with everything you need for a pleasant stay. Highly recommend!

Konumu gerçekten harika, mekanlara ve restoranlara çok yakın. Ulaşım açısından da çok avantajlı; metro daireye yürüme mesafesinde ve her yere kolayca ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Daire çok temiz ve düzenliydi, bu konuda çok memnun kaldım. İletişim de oldukça iyiydi. Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık, mutlaka tekrar tercih edeceğim. Herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

description: Our place is on Serdar-i Ekrem Street and 100 m to İstiklal Street, 150 m to Galata Tower and 100m away from Karakoy sea side.. Our cozy historical apartment is very close to best places in Beyoglu. We have two flats in the same apartment and it's very easy for us to welcome more than +12 guests at the same time with the mirror flats decorated in original way. This listing is 2nd floor of our building.

reviews.text:
It's not so bad, BUT...
pictures are certainly demonstrate apartment at it's best, but in reality it is 30-40% different in my opinion.
Also from pictures it looks like the apartment is huge, but in reality it's not that big.
Also it is a walk up in the old building and there is a concern with the downstairs door - it closes but does not lock, and the apartment door can easily be opened by a thief (I raised that concern to both the host and airbnb). I hope the host finds a solution for it. Because I didnt feel safe leaving my valuable in the apartment.
Also the table was broken (other reviews said it also and it looks like the table was not fixed)
There was a pretty bad leak from the ceiling during our stay and it flooded the kitchen area with dirty water.
And the towels that hosts provided were not super good quality. I also suggested to invest in new towels for your guests.
But it is located in a very nice area of Istanbul and it does have that feeling that you are living in an old building and the view is great from the window and in the bedroom there is back yard (small one), but it's cute.
Communication with a host was ok, but when I presented the issues - hosts would not respond for some time - like the leak in the apartment was not fixed (but host said that it did later), but in reality it got worse. And when I asked for blankets (it was cold to sleep with just bedsheets as blankets) - host said "yeah, yeah will bring it soon" and never brought them.
So suggestion to a host treat your guests a bit with more urgency (we are paying) and fix up your apartment, which is a lovely apartment, but just needs some work.

We chose the flat because of the great reviews and the location, since we stayed in Istanbul for 5 nights. Unfortunately the flat turned out to be a big disappointment. The flat was not clean, leftovers of hair in the shower that did not allow the water to rinse and the toilet was unclean. The flat is not equipped well, for two days we were unable to make a morning coffee even though we told the host directly after our arrival. The table in the kitchen is unusable for eating due to its instability. Overall, the many issues of the flat made our stay uncomfortable. Price for value is not worth it. We even communicated our unhappiness at the end of our stay to the host, he blamed us for staying too long in the flat due to the rainy weather. Despite the great location, we cannot recommend to stay here or longer than 1 night.

Murat's place is gorgeous and just like the photos. The view from the front window is delightful and we found the neighborhood mostly quiet.
The call to prayer was noticeable if the window was open but not obtrusive when it was closed.
There are hills to climb around the apartment but it was so much fun exploring that you can cope.
We found many great artisan shops and small supermarkets to explore and we felt safe in the area. It's a 5 minute walk to shopping street and maybe 10 to Taksim Square.
Restaurants are close and if you can, have a seafood meal near the Galata bridge to get great water views of the Golden Horn.
The windy narrow stairs to the apartment could be challenging for some.
The apartment was aesthetically pleasing but did lack some amenities for cooking and there are some repairs needing attention but Murat will get these done.
Murat was very pleasant and helpful.
We would choose to stay at this apartment again as it was very nice.

The location was great - near tram & metro stations, near shops/restaurants and walking distance to Istiklal Street. The apartment building was quite old, but the flat had character. It was well decorated and had a nice view. The bedrooms were very small but the living room was spacious and having two bathrooms really helped as there were three of us.
One main thing to note, the flat is not for travellers with mobility issues and/or don't have decent strength. You have to go up a few steps to get to the entrance of the building, and climb up a further two flights of the narrow spiral staircase to get to the flat. We had several huge suitcases as it was a long European trip for us, and it was a huge struggle with the suitcases. Took two of us pint-sized ladies (one of whom had a buggered tailbone) to carry each suitcase down when we were leaving, going down a few steps at a time. The apartment could do with a little bit of maintenance. One of the showers was obviously choked and water was draining painfully slowly, so the shower water kept pooling. Shower water was also seeping onto the bedroom floor. The was urine on the toilet seat when we arrived. The blinds in one of the bedrooms was broken/bent in places. We did inform Meltem of these issues (not the blinds, not much she could have done while were there). We were told that the cleaner had already cleaned the apartment but that she didn't check it before we arrived because she had been busy. We arrived at night, it was a pity that she didn't have time to check at any point during the day. Nobody came to fix the shower drainage problem, so we just tried not to turn too much water on while in the shower.
It was such a shame that these issues lessened our enjoyment in the apartment, as we so wanted to love it. And we did have a nice time staying there, but would have been great not to have to deal with the problems.

The apartment was simply great! It was spacious, comfortable, clean, quiet, had everything we needed, and in a splendid location.
Space: there were two of us in the apartment, but even for four people there is ample space, including two full bathrooms with showers. Everything was clean, there were zero problems with check-in, etc. There were nice touches all over the place. Very cozy. We even stayed in one of the days when the weather was bad. Has some perfect reading spots. All other amenities are there, even more than I usually expect.
Location: it has at the same time great location (5 mins from Istiklal and Galata tower, 5 mins from the Sishane metro station, 10–15 mins from Taksim and the ferry station), and it is completely quiet during the night. The bedrooms are on the "inside" of the block, so you can get a good night's sleep.
Host: all communication was prompt, and Meltem was amiable. She didn't have a new check-in the day we left and made no problems for us to stay two hours longer.
Overall: 5/5, will definitely stay there again when in Istanbul.

description: We welcome you to our hotel, which has a warm family atmosphere, for a peaceful, happy and safe stay🙂 Our hotel is located in Pendik Bazaar Center and on the coast, and is also 10 minutes from Sabiha Gökçen Airport.

reviews.text: İlan apart bir oda gibi görünüyordu, ancak My Boutique Hotel'in odasıymış. Konumu mükemmel. Otel oldukça eskimiş. Temizlik eh, ancak banyoda lağım ve küf kokusu yoğundu. Çalışanlar kibardı

A big downside was the communication with the staff, as they barely speak English, which made it quite difficult to communicate. Also, although our flight was scheduled for later that night after check-out, we kindly asked if we could leave our luggage at the hotel so we could spend the day in the city and pick it up on our way to the airport. Unfortunately, the answer was simply “no,” without any alternative solution offered. This was quite disappointing and would definitely be an area for improvement.
Sürekli gittiğim bir yer tavsiye ederim metroya Marmaray’a çok yakın çevrede bir sürü market yemek yeme alanları da mevcut lokasyon olarak çok güzel
Yatakta zor yattık bütün demirler battı çarşafta sigara yanıkları delikler vardı
War super für 1-2 Nächte dank der Nähe zum Flughafen und Busstation. Das Meer und Zentrum ist auch um die Ecke :)

description:
“A modern and quiet apartment in the center of Istanbul, right next to the Yusufpaşa Tram.
A peaceful stay right in the heart of the city.”

reviews.text: Myself and a few other friends stayed at this place, and it was worth staying. It was a remarkable place in terms of location for those of us who want to be near the city, and the cleanliness was very good. The rooms were comfortable, well-maintained, and provided everything we needed for a pleasant stay. The owner was friendly and helpful, always ready to assist whenever required. We also appreciated the peaceful atmosphere, which allowed us to relax after a busy day exploring the area. Overall, it was an enjoyable experience, and I would gladly recommend this place to anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable stay.

We had a wonderful time staying at Murat’s place. He was very responsive, gave us clear instructions and even recommended us some local restaurants that were amazing. The apartment was very clean, comfortable and came with all amenities described on the page. Moreover, Murat was always available for any questions we had and was warm and friendly. Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Istanbul! Amazing experience, best host.

"An absolute 10/10 host! He is extremely helpful, generous, and always ready to assist with anything you need. He helped us so much with our luggage and made our stay completely stress-free. The accommodation was great and as described. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and kind host!"

its nice to stay there ,comfortable, good for family ,clean and neat
near to public transportation

The location is very excellent, reaching all tourist attractions without transportation, Tram ,Metro and buses 1 minute away from the location, the flat was very clean,modern furniture and spacious, Murat is a servant person, kind and gentle. I have been visiting Istanbul for a long time and this is the first time I have enjoyed my holiday.
I highly recommend dealing with Mr Murat because he makes your time enjoyable.
Finally, if I come to Istanbul, Murat 's accommodation will be only option.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
The most outstanding aspect of our stay was how responsive and helpful the hosts were. The apartment was clean and had all the essential amenities we needed. It was in a central location, which made it very easy for us to get around.
It was especially important to me that my cat would have a safe and comfortable place to stay during our transition, and the apartment provided exactly that. All the instructions were clear, which made our stay smooth and hassle-free. I would definitely recommend it.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this accommodation.
The apartment was in a significantly worse condition than I expected from the listing. There was visible mold in the bathroom, damaged and heavily worn furniture, and several areas generally appeared poorly maintained.
The stairwell also had an extremely unpleasant smell. Most importantly, there were two cats living in the stairwell, with food and water bowls provided for them. Their presence was not disclosed in the listing. For me, as someone with a severe cat allergy, this was a major issue and something I absolutely would have needed to know before booking.
I reported the problems to Airbnb and provided photographic documentation.
The location may work for some travelers, but based on the condition, hygiene issues and especially the undisclosed cats, I would not stay here again.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Daire son derece temiz, düzenli ve konforluydu. Konumu oldukça güzel ve ulaşım açısından çok rahattı. Ev sahibi ise ilgili ve her konuda yardımcı oldu. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik.
Airbnb’deki ilk deneyimimizdi ve bizim için gerçekten çok güzel bir başlangıç oldu. İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimizde hiç düşünmeden yeniden tercih ederiz. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz. 🌸🙏🏻

türkiye’deki ilk airbnb deneyimimdi, temizdi gerçekten, bir rahatsızlık yaşamadım. Evde su, çay vs ihtiyaç duyulabilecek şeyler vardı. Klima benim için çok önemliydi. Banyo eşiği kırık/kopmuş gibiydi güvenlik açısından yapılması gerektiğini düşünüyorum. Geç çıkış/ erken giriş konusunda yardımcı oldular sürekli iletişim halindeydik :))) Apartmandaki kediler de çok tatlı

Neredeyse Haftada bir kaç gün aynı bölgede konaklamak zorunda kalıyorum uzun zamandır. İlk defa bu kadar düzenli temiz bir ev ve misafirperver bir ev sahibi gördüm. Her şey için teşekkür ediyorum. Haftaya görüşmek üzere.

description: Stay in a charming historic building in the heart of Beyoğlu, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant and authentic neighborhoods. Located within walking distance of Pera, Galata, Istiklal Street, cafés, restaurants, art galleries, and metro connections. The apartment offers a cozy and comfortable atmosphere, perfect for couples, solo travelers, and digital nomads looking to experience the city like a local while enjoying easy access to Istanbul’s main attractions.

reviews.text: The shower that is not shown in the listing photos, is disgusting. Stains and debri everywhere. Cobwebs on the ceiling. Not hygienic at all.
Harika konum, harika temizlik. Toplu taşımaya 4 dakika yürüyüş, tüm sosyal olanaklara yakın. Teşekkürler

Konum çok iyi yerdeydi birçok yere yürüme mesafesiydi. Ev temizdi ama yanınıza terlik alabilirsiniz. Eve çok kolay giriliyor. Park yeri açısından zorlanılıyor yakında ispark var 15 dakika yürüme mesafesinde

Banyoda ufak sorunlar yaşadık onun dışında her şey gayet güzeldi. Tertemizdi nevresimler vs. Sadece bir odanın kapısının olmayıp sdc perde olması ufak bir sıkıntı yarattı ama zaten fotoğraflarda bu detay gözüküyordu fiystına göre biz memnun kaldık

Le logement était plutôt agréable avec la mise a dispotition de deux ventilateurs très peu bruyant ce qui a beaucoup aidé pendanr le séjour. Malheureusement les photos ne sont pas tant fidèles a la réalité étant donné que la plupart des fenetres mennent sur des murs et l'appartement est globalement très sombre. De plus ce n'est pas vraiment la faute de l'hôte mais les voisins sont extrêmement bruyant vers 23h00-1h30 et bien que l'on entende pas grand chose dans la plus grande chambre, on entend presque comme si on etait dans la même pièce que les voisins dans la deuxieme chambre (d'autant plus qu'ils parlent avec la fenetre ouverte). L'emplacement est plutôt correct et l'hôte est très réactive.

description: Our Cool and minimalists style 2 Bedroom Apartment located at the heart of Istanbul called Pera in Beyoğlu neighborhood. Spectacular Golden Horn view and spirit of the apartment calls you to the travel of the history of Istanbul. Imagine richest civilizations passed from Istanbul and also from Turkey! Drink your Turkish Coffee or Turkish tea or go extreme and try Turkish Raki. Cheers!

reviews.text:
Cons
•Internet never worked.
I specifically told host that we needed internet to work. She assured that the connection was perfect. In reality: You can only find the network in the living room and connection is so incredibly slow that it would take 10 minutes only to load the email inbox. After 4 days complaining about this, she finally admitted that the connection was just slow and that there was nothing to do. We had to spent 40 euros to buy a decent internet connection.
•Poor cleaning
Host is very strict about rules (which I understand and like) but the apartment was not clean. Mostly the floor and the walls were so filthy. It is clear that the “sanitation” was not done. After check-in, I had to do a lot of cleaning myself to be able to be there.
•Worn out
Take in consideration that the photos that you see on Airbnb are from when the apartment was just restored. Now is very worn out and specially the walls need urgent attention as the paint continues to fall off.
The sofas in the living room are also very worn out and uncomfortable.
•Bathroom
Bathroom is excessively small. Is uncomfortable to do anything in that bathroom. In addition to that, the pipes were clogged and when you use the shower or the sink, the water would remain stuck for several minutes. At the end, we wash in the kitchen sink as it was impossible to use the bathroom sink.
Pros
•Host: In general, Hatice explained very well how to get to the apartment and she gave some tips for Istanbul. She was very nice, but I would have appreciated to know the truth about the internet.
•Location: Even when the neighborhood is ugly, the location of the apartment was not bad as we were 10 minutes from the subway station and near to center.
•View: The view from the apartment is nice but it would be better if the windows are clean.
•Heating: Temperature in the apartment was good. Heating worked perfectly.

My wife, kids and mother-in-law stayed at Hatice's place for a week and had a very pleasant experience! The place is exactly as shown and is a cozy apartment that is very comfortable. The view of the city is stunning and we loved seeing Istanbul at night, or at sunrise/sunset.
One thing to note is that the building is located on a very steep hill. And we stayed on the third floor, accessible only by a narrow and winding staircase. So if you have a lot of luggage (as we did), then it will be a serious workout getting everything up and down.
The location of the place is really great: a short walk to the main tourist street and the Metro station is just a short walk away.
Small (very minor) Areas of Improvement: we ran out of toilet paper and because it was the weekend (her maid wasn't in), we had to buy our own. Also, you can't drink the tap water, so Hatice provides a 5 gallon jug of water. But when it runs out, she will order another and you pay for it (it's a small cost).

Except the passport picture request which we refused (cfr. airbnb conditions), the stay went very well. The apartment was very very clean but also handy and the living room has a beautiful view to the Bosphorus. The school next door “rings” from 8 AM. It is a recorded ten seconds song not too annoying but if you plan to sleep late in the bunk beds room then you may need ear plugs. However for the center of a big city the neighborhood is reasonably quiet at night and we slept well.
Hatice provided a set of pictures to reach the apartment easily. The wifi was working well and our host helped us whenever necessary during the stay via the airbnb messaging. The M2 metro is at five minutes walking, Galata tower with bars, restaurants and a high terrasse with amazing view at ten minutes walking, galata bridge with T1 tramway to historical center at 20 minutes walking (steep streets).
I would recommend the apartment.

Me and my family have stayed for 2weeks and we definitely LOVED THE PLACE!The place is exactly as described even BETTER! It has lots of amenities,the sofas and beds were clean,the entire apartment was clean and tidy and felt cozy an definitely like home too!The host was so friendly and helpful until the end of our stay and very quick responsive of every inquiry,really worth our stay.The priceless view from the livingroom window was something that we will never forget for the rest of our lives!We’ve cherishwd every single minute of our stay there.Thank you Hatice for a splendid service and spectacular place of yours!Our family love the place and miss it so much now❤️HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!My 11year old son really enjoyed and missed the cozy apartment too!we gave 10/10 for it!worth paying and worth to stay❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

The place was amazing, there is so much space we were only 3 people but you could easily sleep 5-6 in there. The whole place was very clean and the kitchen was fully stocked if you want to cook. Metro station and bus stop was 3-5 min walk. 5 min walk would take you in the high street.
The check in process was smooth, we did self check in around 9:00pm and communication from the Hatice was always on time and accurate. We got instructions from her how to get to the place.
I would definitely stay again in future

description:
Bask in the afternoon sun on the top-floor balcony, along with water and city views. This historic 4-story Greek House retains its original ceiling and wall paintings, but has been fully renovated, and features objects d'art from all over the world.

We use old furnitures and restored them the same way of the house and matching the colours of the house. There are many pieces coming from around the world during our travels and combination of old and new creates perfect place to live.

There is full kitchen in the house for whom likes to cook in the evening. Owen, full size fridge, dish washer and washer / dryer is in the house. There are two air conditioning in the bedrooms for nice and comfortable sleep.
You will have the whole house for your self and enjoy the beautiful facilities after your long day exploring our amazing city Istanbul.

We live in the same street with the house so anytime you will need something we or our friends will be available

reviews.text:
It was an excellent stay for me and my family. The area is full of the colorful houses. Lots of people to take photos in this area.
I have a few points for those who want to book:
* The house has four floors, which might be challenging for young children. The king bedroom is on the fourth floor while the kitchen is on the first, so there’s a lot of going up and down. Similarly for the property as it is located on a hill, so the area is not flat. Metro station is about 10 meters.
Other than that, everything was exceptionally clean and well organized. The host was very friendly and helpful.

One of the best places to stay in the world!
It's an amazing neighborhood, close to so much stuff, and clean.
Inside, it is like a movie with a historical touch. The hosts are great. They even arrange rides in the middle of the night. They allowed us to drop bags early.
I have been ripped off in Mexico and Turkey, and I thought this was too good to be true, but this is too good! The balcony has a water view! I enjoyed tea. The kids have their own bed. The living room is out of painting.
Tourists walk all day to take pictures in front of these pictures as it is historic!
Every detail is mindblowing: paint, furniture, looks, and even the light switch or fan beautifully match the theme. It's all new, functional, and clean but gives a magical look of old times!

It was a lovely stay. The house is amazing and the neighborhood is an exciting upcoming hipster part of Istanbul. The balcony has amazing views over Istanbul. The interior is full of lovely details and you find all amenities you can wish for. It was also very clean and the beds are very comfy. Restaurant and superb cafes are nearby, cheap and you can find superb food for a small budget. arrival and departure were a little uncomfortable though, since we got a wrong housenumber by arrival by the owner and it was nearly impossible to get a taxi on the way back (by the bytaxi app) - it is a steep hill and I guess many drivers avoid the narrow way. if you don’t have a lot of luggage (as we had) you can easily walk down the hill and stop one of the many taxis at the big road near the water.

This place was beautiful and unique! The rooftop was gorgeous. They even let us stay a little bit late while waiting on picking up a car while the cleaning staff was there. Check in was very easy! Stairs are steep which was not a problem for us. Location was just perfect for the neighborhood, close to restaurants cafes and the water. The kitties outside were so cute and funny and kept trying to get inside!

The place does look like it is out of a magazine, as pictured. However, inaccurately stated there is no AC in living room, or kitchen. There are 4 floors, and only until floor 3 and 4 is there AC. The internet doesnt properly reach the bedrooms on floor 3 and 4; with a Wi-Fi repeater/extender. Also the TV is a 19 inch monitor. Again beautiful place, but with the kitchen on first floor, living room on second, no AC and poor internet as you go upstairs, it just didn't suit me.

description: Situated at the heart of the İstanbul,Two minutes walk to 'Taksim Square' .You will find whatever you need in your own home ;laundry machine,dishwashing machine (etc.). Easy access to your flat from entrance of the building with elevator.65 sqm metres spacious and comfortable flat will make you feel more than at home.

reviews.text: Great location, right next to Taksim square (metro) and Istiklal street which is full of shopping stores. About 20 min walk to Dolmahabce palace. One metro station away from Galata tower. Very nice host, quick to respond and helpful - came pick us up in a street nearby and allowed us to check out one hour and a half later. The place is very clean. And overall good value for money.

Great central place! very easy to get around with close metro access. perfectly clean. Enver was a super welcoming and always helpful host. only downside is that you hear some noise and music all night but that's due to the location. if you want quiet don't go to Taksim ;)

Everything was fine, Mr Enver was responsible anytime, security and safety were great, cleaning was excellent, the atmosphere of the area was great and 5 minutes walk to Taksim square.
But the internet was poor and we weren't happy with that.

A conveniently located place in 300 meters from Taksim Square with an Great Host " Enver"
As I was travelling with family so its special to mention that Mr. Enver took special care in airport pick up & drop ( Paid extras) & also is late check put( 1PM ) & keeping our luggage safe in the store after drop off.
The daily cleaning services in the apartment were very helpful.
Strongly recommended for all fellow travellers
Luvly comfortable place close to Taksim square and Enver is really a helpful host. Hussein

description:
The entire apartment floor is furnished with laminate flooring. There is a mini living room in the common area and a very comfortable red sofa bed and 2 chairs in the living room. The kitchen is ready to use with all its equipment. Refrigerator, stove, dishwasher, toaster, kettle, etc.
In the Guest Room, there is a cute carpet that will cover the middle, a double bed, a wardrobe, a dresser with a mirror, a bookcase, etc.

reviews.text:
My stay had cons and pros: I didn't meet Abdurrahim, but he was communicative and responsive, his brother Ahmet did the check-in and he was nice and helpful and accommodating. They don't live there themselves.
The place is 25min (1.7km) by foot from Taksim's airport bus station and from Taksim is mostly flat/downhill but to get back to the main street it has very steep uphill. Their brother Barat was living in the living room, which I wasn't aware of. Another guest living in the other room. The front door needs to be banged to close and it's hard to open, so leaving early or coming back specially when people are sleeping makes it inconvenient for others. The toilet was constantly leaking and making sounds. The kitchen had dirty dishes left for a couple of days (Barat said they were his friend's) . You need to have your own lock for the room door. WiFi was weak inside the room but ok outside.
Two days there was strong smoking smell in the house, and from what I understood Barat smokes. I wanted a taxi to get to Taksim as it was steep and I had a suitcase, so Ahmed helped to get a taxi for me for 80TKY (I was told taxis don't go short distances), but I cancelled and when I myself got the first one from the street, it cost only 30TKY. Someone also had eaten my breakfast sandwich in the fridge that I wanted to have on the way to the airport. The room itself was spacious and quiet. I've tried to leave an honest review for improvements and future guest expectations.

Mr. Abdurrahim was very interested and kind. The room was very clean, everything I needed was available at the apartment, a good price and a good location, very close to Istiklal street, Taksim square and the metro.
Very easy to find the location, only 230 meters walking from Euro Plaza Hotel if you turn left onto Aynali Çeşme Cd, then turn onto Emin Cami Sk, then turn left onto Çatıkkaş Sk, in front of you you'll see Şahin Apartment.17.
Abdurrahim is not just a AirBNB host to provide a space for you to lay your head, he becomes a tour guide, he will join you in showing you bars, clubs, restaurants and more,very helpful and always replies immediately should you need his assistance.
I highly recommend Abdurrahim’s place if you want to stay in Beyoglu and don’t want to overextend your budget.

It was a good 6 days at Abdurakhim's place. The room corresponds to the description, the location is very convenient, in the center of Istanbul in the Beyoglu district, at an affordable price, Abdurahim and his family are very good people, very helpful, they helped me with everything, I highly recommend, I will return if possible.

Host is very nice and friendly. But it might be difficult to find a location in all side streets.
Anyway it’s almost a city center, walking distance to all main tourist locations.
Nice and simple room.

AirBnB with a nice location and view, the room was ok, the hosts were very friendly. We had some issues with the door (pretty hard to open), the check-in (location was not exact) and the bathroom but overall everything was ok

description:
A completely refurbished 2-storey lovely single house in a historical quarter of Istanbul- Bosphorus area.

A completely renovated, charming detached house in the historical Arnavutköy neighborhood.

reviews.text: I can not thank Lou enough for an incredible 10 night stay in her very special home! In arguably Istanbuls most beautiful picturesque suburb, Lou’s apartment is a 5 minute walk into the lively bars and restaurants of Arnavutkoy and another 2 minutes to the water. I did daily walks to Bebek along the water, stopping to take in the view while enjoying a coffee or ice cream on the go. Lou was very responsive, regularly checking in on me, her home is meticulously clean, and as described. She has seriously thought of everything you could need during your stay! Thankyou Mutlu hanım for everything it was a perfect stay and I can’t wait to come back!

Amazing place with an unmatched view over the Bosporus. It's like a little private house with two bedrooms downstairs and a large beautiful living room upstairs.
It has everything you need plus an amazing host. The neighborhood is just too beautiful and gives endless picture options for posting, as well as for food and coffee. To get to the historic center, you take a boat which is entertaining in itself. You ride along the Bosporus shore with beautiful landscapes for the price of a cookie.
We highly recommend this jewel of a place in one of the most beautiful cities we've been to!

It was a dream place... Shining, cozy, warm, home feeling atmosphere, romantic, spectacular view of the breathtaking Bosphorus. I could watch for hours the beautiful boats with aromatic coffee in my hands, which I found and prepared in that chic kitchen.Very clean and comfortable house. In the kitchen and the whole house, I found everything I needed.
I was welcomed by Lou (amazing person) , who was so kind to show me around and to help me find everything I needed - tasty food, the nice coffee places, a close-by Bosphorus beautiful walk side (Thank you so much). Perfect location - not too crowded, calm, safe neighborhood.
I had the best experience ever.

Wonderful stay! The view from the apartment is amazing. perfect to unwind after a day of sightseeing. Great location with easy access to buses to Beşiktaş and Kabataş. The neighborhood feels truly local and authentic. The apartment was very clean, everything worked well and the Wi-Fi was reliable. Lou was a kind and helpful host, flexible with check-in and very respectful.
Only small note: one of the single beds made a bit of noise – nothing major.
Highly recommended!

The stay at Mutlu's house was one of my best airbnb experiences. She is was very easy to communicate with, informative and attentive to all my requests for a pleasant stay at her place. She was prompt to let me into the house and also willing to inform me about the area. The house is very conveniently located, close to shopping, beautiful Bosphorous, pubs, cafes and restaurants in a safe area with easy access to parking. I was also able to enjoy my daily morning walks by the Bosphorous which is a ten minute walk to Mutlu's house. The house its self is very tastefully decorated, homy, cosy , spacious, super clean with a stunning view of the Bosphorous. It also has everyting from TV, to wireless internet, from all kictchen utentils to beautiful bed covers. Not to forget an amazing book collection and fresh flowers. I am already looking forward to my next visit at Mutlu's house. It is a gem of a place. Thank you Mutlu for such a wonderful stay in Istanbul. I felt completely at ease and at home.

description:
Underground with style, sun light with shared garden .


“NOTE: Check my other Houses with same design style “

reviews.text:
James is really kind and the airbnb was bigger and better than the photos. I arrived a bit earlier than check-in time really ill and not feeling so hot. James let me check-in early and was always available in case I needed anything. It was very cozy, beautifully designed and clean.
The neighborhood is central and great for tourists, but on the quieter side, especially the small lane the unit is located. Though close to the center, the neighorhood is on the loftier side, with small intimate cafes, vintage shops, and amenities. Highly recommend for couples, or singles like myself who generally likes to hermit after an exhausting day of sightseeing and travel.
Great place and worth every bang for its buck. Will definitely book again next time I come to Istanbul, if James' places isnt't, if most likely, already booked!

Couldn’t be in a more perfect location - european cosmopolitan neighbourhood filled with fun side streets with cool cafes and boutiques. Easy walk down to tram stop to cross river to blue mosque, grand bazaar, hagia sophia etc. Short walk up to a main shopping strip. Quite a hilly area so be prepared to hike the cobble stone streets.
Overall the apartment was bit grimy and could do with a good clean but if you’re not fussy, it adds to the artisan flare of the place. The appartments interior is extremely spacious and well thought out, a piece of art in every nook which makes for a unique stay. Kitchen was not very well equipped for cooking a basic meal and some utensils, cutlery & plates were dirty. Appartment was also missing a number of essential items (toilet paper, bath mat, dish washing liquid, tea towels & extra bin liners) which would have made the stay more comfortable.
Great wifi, good shower pressure, comfy queen bed with sturdy pillows, nice linen and towels.
If I stayed again I would probably book the next floor up as the basement was pitch black and dead silent at night time and we found it kind of scary.
James has a great list of tips and tricks to get you started in Istanbul. Some awesome restaurant and roof top bar suggestions too. Helpful guy who always responded quickly to our messages.

The main advantage of the apartment is its great location, close to the city center. Otherwise, be prepared for a musty smell, high humidity, damp bedding, a leaking ceiling in the kitchen during rain, unexpected slugs guests and cobwebs. It looks a bit different from the photos, but it is just a basement after all

We enjoyed our time in Istanbul very much and James' house is one of the reasons for it.
It was a pleasant experience to stay in the penthouse loft. There are two different feelings and expressions to the loft, but all have one idea: fusion from old and modern Turkey, stone and wood, steel and glass, history and the present time.
The loft incorporates good modern lighting for privacy, darkness, and all user needs, including wonderful natural light. This is a place with special artistic interior design and many interesting decisions. By the way, a very comfortable bed, tasty tea, and mix of new and vintage cutlery and kitchenware in the kitchen.
Located near the Galata Tower, the flat is easy to locate, and has fantastic views of the city.
The penthouse develops the idea of fusing the best and adds the idea of air and Bosphorus to stone and wood, steel and glass.
At first, you go upstairs to the penthouse and understand that it is very high, then you see the steel wall and the wood ceiling, and large panoramic windows, open balcony with a great view of the city and the Bosphorus, with two terraces to enjoy morning tea and the beautiful sunrise over the city.
By the way, a little surprise - you can see part of this view when taking a shower or you are in bed. The kitchen windows let you understand the typical city-center life.
This place has many comfortable places to talk and the kitchen is one of them. A steel spiral Stairway to Heaven goes up and leads to a fantastic view- both sides of Istanbul (European and Asian coasts), the Bosphorus, Hagia Sophia, ferries, sky, gulls, and wind. Comfortable chairs and sofa let you stay and "hold on" to your usual everyday thoughts and dreams. A very comfortable and relaxing environment.
Next time we visit, we will be calling James.
Craig and Nadiia - James's guests in October

Unfortunately we did not have a good experience here. The host said he had fallen asleep on our arrival time, so we had to find our own way in. There was no hot water in the shower and many lights were not working so the place is like a dark dungeon. Also there was a moldy/damp smell in the appartment. The next day we contacted the host. After sending another message someone came over to fix the warm water. The lights could not be fixed on short term. They did try to give a desk lamp to place in toilet though. We told him it was not acceptable and the host suggested to cancel the reservation and reimbourse the remaining days. The host then pressed us to cancel it as soon as possible so he could get new guest asap. Also told us to contact airbnb ourselves to get money back. This is first time I would not recommend people to stay at a place. Airbnb was very helpfull in the situation.

description:
This is truly the best location between Galata(where is the art and architecture heaven of the city)& Karakoy (where you have an amazing sea and nice restaurants) you can take a walk to all attractions. The decoration made for your comfortable and lovely stay plus you have a really nice view of the tower and bosphorus from the rooftop.Apart from all these pros it is one of the calmest places around the town.We are waiting for you

* we just have an air conditioner so you will have a cool stay.

reviews.text: This place was as advertised. The check in was easy and flawless with the host’s clear instructions. There are two working AC units that made a great difference. The place is small but cozy with all the necessary kitchen utensils and toiletries needed for a comfortable stay. The accessible roof top was a great addition for a beautiful city view for additional picture taking. The place is in a walkable distance to grocery, restaurants and a tram stop to get around. I can recommend this place to anyone who is planning an affordable stay with all the necessities provided by the host.

Eyup's listing is a good value for money and very walkable to most attractions in Galata. Eyup, Ali and their father, they're all very proactive in communication and they'll go out of their way to make sure you have a comfortable stay. They also prepaared lots of guides and recommendations that helped us. They even extended themselves to make some arrangements before and after our stay.
For a group of 2, this is a comfortable stay. Just be mindful that the rooms are a bit smaller than the photos. But it never felt uncomfortable.

Eyup met us in the evening to check us in, and was very nice and helpful. There is no elevator, and the apartment is on the third floor, so be aware of that. But the space is perfect for a couple traveling in Istanbul. It is located 2 minutes form the Tram which can take you to Taksim Square or Sultanhamet quickly, and also a 5 minute walk from Galata tower or Istiklal street, so there is lots to do. Eyup provided some water and snacks which was very thoughtful. The bed was comfortable and the AC unit helped a lot in the heat of late August. There were also all the essentials if you wanted to make coffee/tee/food/etc, like silverware, cups, and other kitchen items. We enjoyed our stay here very much.

We had a great stay. Eyüp was extremely responsive and helpful and accommodating. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and the AC really kept the bedroom very cool which was great! We enjoyed the rooftop and it's right in the middle of the action in Beyoglu near Galata tower, without being loud. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Good and clean appartment. The host was very helpful and replied quickly. They even provided some drinking water which was really nice because I arrived at night and stores were closed. Also I think that the location is perfect as the street doesn't get crowded and noisy, while being close to transport (subway, tram, ferries) so you can get to most touristy places in no time.
Unfortunately there were some technical issues such as a crack in the ceiling that was leaking on a rainy day (seemed dangerous because there's a socket below) and a noisy boiler in the bedroom. I hope they'll provide some maintenance to these.

description:
My 40 sqm studio apartment is tastefully decorated with use of white and wooden colour tones, and the original stone work details. I hope this will offer you a perfect alternative for your short or long stays, for business or leisure trips.
The flat comes with all the modern amenities like Wi-Fi, satellite, LCD TV, comfortable bedding and much more.

reviews.text:
Murat's apartment, located a short walk away from the Galata tower in Beyoglu, is exactly as described on Airbnb. It's a very cute space in a fantastic location that provides easy access to all the major tourist attractions of Istanbul. Keep in mind however, that although the area is tourist-friendly, it's also very gentrified. Expect to find cafes and restaurants that are significantly more expensive than in other less-touristy parts of Istanbul (for example on the 'Asian side').
The apartment is fitted with all the conveniences for a comfortable (short- or long-term) stay, including Wi-Fi, heating, a microwave, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, stove, and kitchenware. The space is more than enough for 2 people, and can, at a stretch, host 3-4 people for a short stay.
Murat himself is super easy to communicate with and provided us with clear, prompt and helpful information whenever we had a question. Some prior guests seem to have had trouble with the bed, which they reported as 'too hard', but we found it very comfortable and didn't have to resort to sleeping on the couch.
TL; DR: We highly recommend Murat's Airbnb to all visitors and tourists in Istanbul. No complaints at all! :) Thank you, Murat, for a lovely Airbnb experience!

I'd recommend this apartment only if you are okay with its minor issues.
Let's start with problems I've faced with:
- Bed was super firm. From the scale from 1-10 (where 1 is pile of feathers and 10 is concrete floor) - its solid 8. I mean, I've slept on firm mattresses. But this bed is on the whole another level. If you are very sensitive for your sleeping spot - consider that. My girlfriend did not sleep well for a week during our stay.
- Apartment has a second sleeping spot - sofa. When folded, sofa is fine. However, I tried to unfold it (because it is soft compared to bed) and turns out a part of sofa just falls off. You just cannot sleep on it in unfolded state.
- Central heating was leaking drops of water. It was annoying during night, I couldn't sleep. I ended up notifying owner and put a cup to prevent hardwood floor from being wet.
- Signs of mold on the bathroom walls. Vent is not enough apparently.
- Shower cabin is leaking, it does not keep water inside properly. Also notified owner about that. I had to clean up bathroom floor outside cabin after every single shower.
- I tried my best, but could not find a way to turn on cable TV. Maybe it was just me. But I bet it does not work. I did not have much time for TV, so... whatever.
Now, here's a list of great things about apartment:
- Street is very quiet.
- It is located in city center. There's a few cafes 10-50 meters away from apartment.
- Communication with owner Murat was super quick and nice.
- There's huge bottle of drinking water in apartment - very convenient. A lot of apartments do not offer that.
- Apartment has washing machine, that was crucial to me.
- Overall, place is small and comfy.
- Wi-Fi is quick and stable.
- Air conditioner! It's great, it works, but it blows directly on bed.
I will be honest, bed was the most annoying thing. Everything else apart of that we could deal with.
Pictures of apartment look amazing but I bet they were taken at least a couple of years ago. You can see small signs of damage here and there. Broken picture frames, teared curtains, mold on bathroom walls, etc.
Overall, my experience was fine in that apartment. Will I visit it once again? Uh... not sure. I prefer comfort.

we stayed in Murat’s apartment for 4 nights, and we really enjoyed our stay.
The apartment is located on a super quiet cosy street, 2 minutes from Galata tower - it’s just up the road literally. amazing. the area is ideal for getting out and about - you can walk everywhere on foot. Cihangir is 15 mins away tops, the port with its many cafes and bars - also about the same, very convenient getting on a ferry to the Asian part of Istanbul as well. even the old city with its historical sites is only about 30 mins on foot.
the apartment is very atmospheric, located on the top floor of an old gorgeous building with winding stairs. those coming with heavy luggage though, keep in mind - there’s no lift, and the stairs are really narrow. good workout though!
the flat has all the amenities you need - washer, dryer, dishwasher, stove etc. there’s boiler heating, very warm. wifi is great. water pressure is really good.
Murat was super helpful and replied to all questions instantly. special thanks for allowing us to leave our luggage on checkout at the nearby gym - the security guy was wonderful, managed to get us a taxi to the airport on a busiest holiday.
the only real con i can think of is the bed, which is super firm. i’m not used to such mattresses, was a bit hard on the back, so i’d really prefer something softer.
also, the interior of the flat is a bit dated, i mean it’s beautifully designed, but needs some fresh paint in the bathroom, where there’s some mold in places, and the hardwood floor has seen better days. but overall the apartment is really clean and cosy.
i’d definitely recommend this place to stay! thanks a million for the hospitality.

For context, this was my first time in Istanbul and I spent 6 nights here. This was the perfect location! Perfectly situated to Galata, Taksim square, the ferries, the Old Town, Kabata... everywhere. I loved coming home to this apartment each day - it's around the corner to Galata Tower so it's very touristy, but the street itself is local and quiet. There are nice coffee shops, cafes and breakfast spots just steps from the apartment. I highly recommend Galata Kitchen for lunch or dinner!
Very easy to find and access the apartment. It's up a few flights of stairs but nothing crazy. The automatic lights shut off very quickly so I did have to wave my hand to give myself time to lock / unlock the door. The apartment is more 'lived in' than the photos portray but regardless, very clean and comfortable. Hot water and shower pressure is great!
I used the washing machine / dryer and it was OK. I'd recommend giving yourself time to hang dry.
I would totally stay here again!

I stayed at Murat's place for one night, but I had to cancel for unforeseen reasons. It was my first night in Istanbul and I must say that Murat was an understanding and excellent host. Murat followed the cancellation policy to the letter and we reached an agreement that was fair for both of us. He also offered to store my luggage until check-in time and contacted me as soon as the property was clean and ready for check-in and a very kind lady brought me bottled water to the apartment. The apartment is located in one of the liveliest districts of Istanbul (which is a great thing) and surrounded by cafes, restaurants, souvenir shops, the Galata's Tower and is easily accessible by public transport and the internet service is great. However, the property does not look like the pictures on the listing. The apartment has already seen better days and could benefit from a remodel, including a lick of paint, air conditioning unit, floor polishing, new mirror and mold removal in the bathroom.

description: The carpenter Andon from Heybeliada decides to build a house on Burak Reis Street in 1928. The house was completed in 1930, and its lower floor is made of stone, upper floor is masonry gypsum, ceiling and floors are wooden. Andon the carpenter lived in this house for many years. No one had lived in this house for many years after his death. The new owner started the restoration in 2003. In 2004, a new life began in this renovated house surrounded by flowers. There's woods in the back of the house, blue as far as the eye can see in the front and just the sounds of birds in the mornings...

reviews.text: The flat is lovely and just as described and shown in the pictures. The flat is located a 10 min uphill walk from the town center, however it is worth the view from up there. We did not manage to have hot water and the radiator did not work but since we only had a short stay and were outside all day we also did not bother to ask, I am sure Alpteking would have helped quite quickly he responded very reliable and responsible. We would definitely come back!

We very much enjoyed our three day stay at Alptekin's place. It is pretty much as described in the ad: a simple, yet very cozy and beautiful flat. Considering the fact that it was one of the cheapest offers on the island, this place has a great value for the money we paid. The view is worth the walk up the hill. Alptekin was very helpful and the contact with him was pretty easy, both in English and Turkish. If we ever come back to Heybeliada (and we sure want to) we will surely stay with him again.

Nice location, clean flat, great view, smooth check-in. We had a great weekend at the island in Alptekins flat and everything we needed was there (kitchen, bathroom, bedroom fully equiped). Also the heating worked well (for those who want to come in the winter months). The only little minus point: the drain stank so we had to ventilate every time we came home.
We would love to come back one day!

Le séjour chez Alptekin et Hamdi s'est très bien déroulé. La terrasse est très agréable. Toutes les commodités sont conformes aux photos et le logement est vraiment propre.
Il y a environ 10 minutes de marche depuis le port, le logement se trouve en haut d'une pente.
Le propriétaire est réactif et disponible.
Je recommande vivement ce logement.
The stay at Alptekin and Hamdi's place was very well. The terrace is very pleasant. All the amenities are as shown and the accommodation is really clean.
It is about 10 minutes walk from the port, the accommodation is at the top of a slope.
The owner is responsive and available.
I highly recommend this accommodation.

Alp Tekin bey çok güzel bir ev kurmuş, fotoğraflarda iyi gözüküyor fakat gerçekte dahada güzel. Kendisiyle iletişimimiz çok rahat gerçekleşti. İster çalışmak için gelin ister dinlenmek için, eminim burası herkesi memnun edecektir. Evin lokasyonu adanın tepesine çok yakın, merdivenlerden yukarı devam ederek oradaki manzaraya uğramanızı tavsiye ederim. Tekrardan teşekkürler.

description:
Located within 50 metres of Istiklal Street and 450 metres of Galata Tower in Istanbul, Dorne Suite Taksim provides accommodation with seating area.

The air-conditioned units come with a kitchenette that includes a fridge, a private bathroom with a hairdryer, and a living room with a flat-screen TV. A stovetop and kettle are also provided.

Popular points of interest near the aparthotel include Taksim Square, Dolmabahce Clock Tower and Spice Bazaar.

reviews.text:
Positives:- Great value for money - secure entrance with staff, warm, near the centre of Istiklal street (and very near Hookah Place, if you’re into that) good heating/air-conditioning. Comfortable, large furniture.
Negatives:- The bed creaks a bit. The windows are thin but it’s not close to any popular nightlife spots so it’s not much of a problem. Minor ware and tear issues but it’s not a 5 star hotel so better than most Airbnbs.
Definitely a good choice. We spent $60 per night and thought it was excellent value compared to the many others we’ve stayed at in the same area.

Dorne suite is excellent place. Location is great. You can find all you need around you. Istiklal street is just 1 minute away. Tram and metro stations 15 minutes walking distance.
The stuff is very helpful. Especially Sinan. He even arranged for us PCR laboratory in hotel. Hotel itself is very good, clean and cozy.

We were happy to find this place after moving out of a precious Airbnb. We felt much safer and more comfortable at Dorne Suite and in the surrounding streets. Awesome area, food and boutique shopping at your doorstep. Lots of hip young people in the area.
The apartment was super clean, beautiful lighting design, spacious, comfy, and having the elevator was great for our luggage. We will be highly recommending this place for any friends visiting Istanbul for the first time.

Every thing was great and very helpful reception and this more better if you are in boys trip and family but child should be more then 8 to 9 years old overall all best communication best location quite area in the morning as well
Hope to come again.
This place is conveniently located and the stuff is super helpful. Recommended!

description:
Our hotel has 5 floors and there is a 45 m2 1+0 apartment on each floor.

The walking distance to the transportation points of our hotel, Marmaray and metrobus lines, can vary between 5 and 7 minutes. You can easily get to Sabiha Gökçen Airport by using Marmaray and transferring to the subway at Ayrılıkçeşmesi station.

You can quickly access many social and cultural activity areas such as Moda Coast, Kalamış Marina, Fb stadium, Museum Gazhane.

reviews.text: First of all, the location is perfect! The host seems to want to fulfill all our wishes. It is clean, but it has not been renovated for a long time. However, people were doing renovations at the moment we were resting there and this is my first problem! The host apologized that the state obliges them to do this renovation, but did not warn us about it when we booked! If we had known that we would hear this loud noise from the stairs and the smell of smoke and metal, we would not have booked! The other problem was the small bathroom! The distance from the toilet to the wall was literally 20 cm and a normal person cannot sit on it! This was a big inconvenience! The WIFI was not good, but we know that we are not at home and we ignored it. The photos on AirBnb were not exactly of this apartment! Leaving these problems aside, the location was great with parks, bus stops, shops, restaurants. The problem is that the host should have warned us about the inconveniences so that we had the right

Melih is a very responsive host, was in touch all the time.
The apartment looks better on the photos than in reality.
Overall the furnishings are ok, but the apartment is worn out, the kitchen had stains and dirt inside the cabinets, in the shower room we couldn't figure out how to turn on the water in the middle of the night, we had to shower in cold water. The bathroom is very small.
Overall it is not a bad option to stay for 1-2 nights.
A separate plus that there is an elevator in the house. We wish the team good luck and prosperity to the apartments.

As a place to "just sleep" - great, but definitely not worth the money. The location is great, there are places for breakfast, restaurants for every taste, beautiful parks nearby. The apartment itself needs significant repairs, the toilet constantly leaks, the shower has an unstable water temperature. The bed linen is clean, but very old. The location of the sockets is inconvenient, a nail sticks out of one socket. The tap in the kitchen drips loudly. At night, noise from the street is audible, but it does not interfere with sleep at all.

This was a broken hotel room not a “serviced apartment”. Host was responsive and the guys at the location were cool and helpful but they dont understand the meaning of the Airbnb experience”.
This place is in a great district but the hotel is low quality and not worth what I paid.

Otelin konumu her yere ulaşım için çok iyiydi. İçerisi temiz ve havalandırışmıştı.
Gerekli bilgi ve yardım konusunda işletmeci ilgiliydi. Güvenlik açısından bina girişinde akıllı sistem ve kameralar mevcuttu. Bizi tek olumsuz etkileyen konu odanın cephesinin tamamen camdan oluşması oldu. Dışa bakan cephe cam olduğu için ses izolesi zayıf oluyor haliyle biraz dışarının gürültüsüne maruz kalıyorsunuz. Belki de biz giriş katta olduğumuz içindir bilmiyorum. Bunun dışında etrafındaki çoğu konum yaya gezilebilecek yerler yakınında ispark var. Otelin arka kısmında araç park yerleri de mevcuttu. Bu konumda tekrar kalmak istersek fiyat/performans tercih edeceğim bir işletme olur.

description: Modern designed apartment in a new building. Full equipment of kitchen, private bathroom.

reviews.text:
It is a minimal room with listed amenities. It is good value for such a cheap price I guess. Its closeness to the subway and bus stops, and walking distance to Nişantaşı is definitely a big strength.
The room was clean and tidy enough when I arrived. There are minor things I wasn’t comfortable with, such as the bathroom sometimes having a bad smell and the AC making my lungs feel stuffed at night. Also, the shampoo and the shower gel they give you is of poor quality imo, you can bring yours yourself.
It is one of those hotels that you are expected to come, stay and go, and don’t complain too much about it. There is always someone at the reception desk if you need something.
Finding a parking spot for your car is a big problem as well in this neighborhood. I gave lots of money to questionable parking services and also paid a fine for illegal parking.
I think it is well worth the price after all. I still would give the extra 1k-2k and stay at somewhere more comfortable.

This was my second stay here - and again it was excellent.
The location is great - near to shops, restaurants and Metro but off the main road and quiet. Not next to tourist spots but didn’t need that.
Rooms are great - clean, comfortable and exactly like the photos. Great to have a full kitchen to cook…but know it is one big room to cook, eat and sleep in.
The support from all the staff is great. There is a 24hr reception where they are super friendly and always happy to help.
If you want the ease of a hotel with ability to cook in your own kitchen, in a great location then this is a great choice.

Pros: Very friendly welcome. Neat and clean bed and bathroom.
Cons: Not in the location it says, but not very far from it too. The couch in the entrance room was stained and smell of smoking vas noticeable. The price is at least 15%-20% above what it should be.

Stayed for one night while attending a concert in the neighborhood. Good stay overall, definitely worth your money (thought price is more justified for couples than single stays). The entrance is situated in a back alley from the main street, relatively close to public transportation, so it was straightforward to get to here from the IST airport via an M11 metro + 46T bus combo (reverse route was just as easy: 48N + M11). Also close to local markets, which is useful if you want to cook for yourself. Bed was comfortable, utilities were working without problems. Desk staff was friendly, helpful, and available 24/7. Would return for a second stay.

Small apartment located close by the congress center in a quiet street. Easy access and flexible arrival. Comfy bed but very few kitchen items that were quite dirty.
The Taksim place is not too far (15min walking distance) and you can catch a bus to visit the old Istanbul. I recommend going on the boulevard nearby or at the congress center to catch a taxi if you want to go for a trip or to the airport (there are a lot passing by)

description: If you are planning a nice vacation in the comfort of your home, our apartments in Büyükada, which are within a 3-minute walking distance to the pier, offer you, our valued guests, the pleasure of having a nice vacation in Istanbul with their magnificent street and city views.

reviews.text:
Great location. Nice clean well stocked apartment. Good communication with host.
Noise from upstairs apartment was a little disruptive but I understand this is an issue with a lot of properties on the Adalar. First two nights totally fine. 3rd night a group of guests arrived and it was a struggle to sleep above the noise.

The apartment is great! Super clean and very well located! The employees were quick the small issues we had with hot water and making a fire! I would definitely recommend :) If you plan on cooking a lot, maybe bring a few equipments because there’s not a lot in the flat
Ev gerçekten fiyat performans eviydi. Konumu harika her yere çok yakın. Ev de temizdi

Ev sahibi konaklamamız öncesinde verdiği talimatlarla hızlı bir şekilde oteli ve ofisi bulmamızı sağladı. Konumu merkeze çok yakın olduğu için ulaşım konusunda hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık. Ev hem temiz hem de ferahtı, ana ihtiyaçlarımızın tümünü bulabildik. Çok keyifli bir konaklama geçirdik, teşekkür ederiz.
It was an amazing experience. very clean and cozy apartment. Close to the souq, services, and to the ferry station yet quiet. They are very kind and very helpful.

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the hearth of Istanbul's historic peninsula?
