This booking offers a fully equipped design apartment in Taksim, across the iconic Golden Horn view. It is located at just a few minutes from the famous Istiklal street, night life, public transits, historic places and all the prestigious museums.

With a 3rd wave coffee shop at the lobby, daily cleaning service and personal assitance for all kinds of concierge needs, this apartment is to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text: Mehmet’s apartment is one of several in a great modern building with stunning views over the Golden Horn and the historic Pera Palace Hotel (if you ignore the car park). I stayed in the 5th floor apartment which was modern and very clean. Great to have a Smart TV too for entertainment when you’ve finished exploring. The aircon works really well so you can always be cool been when it’s 30 degrees outside. Bathrooms are small but the shower works really well. Bed in main bedroom was medium firm and decent to sleep on. The kitchen isn’t really suitable for a meal but you can heat up a takeaway. I had a great stay and will be back. Perfect place in central Istanbul for seeing the sights and being near great restaurants. Mehmet was really helpful for takeaway food tips when the city was in lockdown. Also worth checking out his guidebooks. I had the best Turkish food at the Galata Lily Cafe - highly recommended!

The place is old and dirty and does not match the photos. The photos must have been taken many years ago as the place is trashed. The furniture is heavily used and dirty. The place is filled with toilet smell masked with a very strong air freshener. The paint is peeling everywhere and there are finger prints on all the surfaces. The bedrooms are tiny and the bed doesn’t match the size of a queen bed, it’s much smaller. Literally the only positive thing is the location.
We stayed at another airbnb for a week before checking into this property and had a fantastic experience there so this was such a downgrade. Thankfully airbnb processed a full refund due to the fact that the place did not match the photos and was in a horrendous condition. We were blessed with another amazing find and we were able to check into the new place right away.

while the stay was pleasant, and there are pros about the place, the number of cons definitely didn't justify the price.
pros:
- great location, right between Galata and taksim.
- lovely view from the living room
- functional kitchen
cons:
- the 'rooms' which were essentially glass boxes' didn't close, so there was not really privacy. the door was a sliding panel that didn't lock or latch in place. if not travelling with immediate family, this is a huge drawback. no privacy at all
- bathrooms had a stale lingering smell. Since one bedroom had attached bathroom, that smell also came into the room.
- really small bathrooms, especially given the price. not even space to keep toilet bags
- the second bedroom's window opened into the shaft so no sunlight in that room
essentially it's a large studio apartment converted into a two bedroom place. while the location and the view from the living area is amazing, the place was small and not the best stay

description:
The apartment is located in a central and lively part of Nişantaşı, just a 1-minute walk from Migros supermarket, Snap Fitness, and many cafés, restaurants, and pubs.
The American Hospital is only a few minutes away on foot, making the location especially convenient.

City’s Nişantaşı shopping mall can be reached in 2–3 minutes by walking.
The Osmanbey metro station is 500 meters from the apartment, providing quick access to the rest of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The pictures are very accurate. The apartment is beautifully furnished and tasteful. So many wonderful details. Everything feels new and it feels like a home. Some airbnbs are a collection of random left-overs but this is not the case for this apartment.
The kitchen has everything you need to cook and make meals-- important due to COVID and lock downs! The furniture including the beds are very comfortable. The balconies are lovely to have some extra outside space. All of the bedrooms have windows and storage for clothes and are a good size. The hot water and water pressure are terrific (I have very long hair so this is important). We also used the bathtub and there was plenty of hot water to fill it. The big room upstairs has a lot of sunlight. I suggest a couch to make it more cosey in front of the fire (fyi, the fire place does not provide heat, but is a nice touch). For an Istanbul apartment it has a lot of space. There is also a bedroom on the first floor for those who have mobility challenges and the elevator was key as I had heavy suitcases. Also baby gates on either end of the staircase for those with little ones.
The location was also very quiet which is highly unusual for Istanbul. The neighbors are not loud which is great. The building itself is secure and nice.
If you like high end shopping; or need to be near the American Hospital, this is a great location. Nisantisi is less about cultural tourism and more about shopping tourism. The restaurants are also a bit high end; however, because many were closed for COVID and the kitchen was so well equipped, we cooked a lot. (btw: there were so many basics in the kitchen, you don't have to start from scratch so check out what is in there before grocery shopping). Migros grocery store is a 3 minute walk away with some smaller shops even closer. Sappa is a fantastic pizza place with gluten-free pizza and is literally less than a minute walk around the corner. Osmanbey metro about 10 minutes walking.
The smart TV worked well. The internet overall was fine; streamed fine and had zoom calls fine. With some boosting for the second floor it will be perfect. Washing machine was easy enough to use and clothes dried relatively quickly on the rack.
Enise was a wonderful hostess. She check in on us a few times (we were there for 12 days); responded quickly when we sent messages. She also let us "check in" before check in time and leave our bags while we wondered until the official check in time. Place was very clean. Thank you, Enise for a great trip!

All rooms do not have AC and this is already mentioned.
We asked the host to put fans, and indeed two fans were placed in two out of the 3 rooms.
In fact, we could not stand the heat
the beds isn't comfortable at all :(
The bathroom in one of the master room does not have a toilet, only a shower and a sink. It smells bad throughout our stay.
And needed to go the the living room toilet to use it. (Which is located in front of the master room).
For those who have a car, there is parking lot with fee nearby.
There is no possibility of parking at all on the nearby streets.
There are a lot of dogs and poultry sounds around the house, especially in its rooftops, which are close to the apartment located in the 3rd top floor.
The curtains in the bedrooms aren't sunblock.
The internet does not reach the upper floor. Only on the ground.
The living room is large and beautiful and the kitchen has all the necessities.
Other than that, everything mentioned is correct.
The host is Quick to respond, nice and speaks English.. she let us use her login name on the food app to order from as we arrived late in the night.
easy check in and out.

We stayed for couple weeks, it was very smooth check-in process since we had overnight flight.
The location is just perfect.
The apartment does not have AC on the bedroom, but there are only fans. It was hot actually. So if you are coming on the summer I would not recommend it for you.
All bathrooms need to be checked and maintained.
The bathroom on the master room has very very bad smell and it does not include toilet, only a shower.
The lighting on the upper floor is very minimum.
The host is very supportive and helpful, but when we discovered that the apartment does not have AC on the bedrooms, which was 3 weeks before our check-in date, She refused to cancel the booking and that was disappointing as the price is not cheep, so we were expecting AC on all of the bedroom as we were in August.

It was one of the best experiences I’ve ever had as an Airbnb guest.
First of all, the location is perfect — right in the heart of Istanbul’s European side, close to some of the best cafés, shops, and markets. As we were traveling with a small baby, it was a big plus that there is a lovely park just a 10-minute walk away.
The neighborhood is very quiet and pleasant, and the building itself is small, newly built, and only five floors, which made our stay even more comfortable.
The apartment is absolutely perfect: spacious, extremely comfortable, beautiful, and very stylish. Just like in the photos. It has everything you could possibly need at home — we truly felt like we were in our own place. The bedrooms and beds are very comfortable, and the two fully equipped kitchens were a great bonus. I would rate the comfort a solid 10 out of 10.
Enisa is a wonderful host — very friendly, kind, easy to communicate with, and always helpful.
My highest recommendations for this apartment.

We stayed here for just over a week with our extended family and had a wonderful experience. The location is excellent—quiet and safe, yet only steps from grocery stores, bakeries, coffee shops, restaurants, and great shopping. Public transportation is just a 5–6 minute walk away, with easy connections to ferries, the metro, the Asian side, and the airport.
The apartment was spotless and truly felt like a home away from home. All three bedrooms and the living room had air conditioning, which was essential during Istanbul’s summer. The kitchen was well equipped, and the host thoughtfully provided a teapot, electric kettle, plenty of cookware, extra towels, and bed linens.
Although slightly more expensive than other three-bedroom apartments nearby, it offers excellent value. We rented another Airbnb in the same neighborhood for our family, and this one was far superior. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

reviews.text:
The neighborhood is beautiful, and the apartment building is quiet and clean. The location is excellent, with easy access to public transportation and many attractions.
The hosts were very responsive and helpful. They quickly addressed any issues we had, and the airport transfer and luggage storage services made our stay more convenient.
The apartment is quite old. Although there is an elevator to the fourth floor, there is still one flight of stairs to reach the apartment, which was not mentioned in the listing. The bathroom drain had an unpleasant sewage smell, and the shower water kept changing between hot and cold. The shower hose also broke during our stay but was replaced the next day.
At check-in, some linens and towels were missing, and there was no fan, pot, or teapot until we requested them. Also, no basic essentials such as hand soap, dish soap, laundry detergent, or toilet paper were provided.
Overall, we had a pleasant stay, but it could be better.

Location is really good, the neighbourhood is really nice , easy access to Isteklal street and grocery is just next door. There are lots of restaurants and cafes near by. specially vegan restaurants which was great for us. The unit also is clean and bed is convenient. The main kitchen equipments are good and new but the basics like dishes, cups and silverware are very basic and some broken. We had a serious problem with WiFi, Oguz tried to help but since the access point is located downstairs, internet speed is slow and frequently disconnected.

### Very Good Stay
We had a very pleasant stay at Emre Yakışır’s place. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Communication was easy, and Emre was helpful and responsive throughout our stay. Overall, we were very satisfied and would happily stay here again.
One thing to keep in mind is that the top floor does not have elevator access, and the stairs are quite narrow, so it may be a little difficult if you have heavy luggage or mobility concerns. Apart from that, everything was very good. Highly recommended!

It was a nice place to stay in,and host was a nice person almost instantly replying to anything you ask him for, easy to find the building with the owner instructions, clean and everything is working as in the description such as AC,iron, hair drier...etc and so peaceful and quiet and the neighbors were so friendly and the location of the building in a safe area like literally in the center of all the important places close to transportation and famous places to visit and you have groceries and supermarkets restaurants exactly of 5 secs walking even a pharmacy or hospital in case
Before I come I was thinking of seeing at least some domestic flies but we haven't seen a single one of them that how was clean the place is, even I extended my staying more because I liked the place and the owner helped me so much when I asked him.
I recommand everyone to book it because I would do the same next time without bothering to look for others and it's worthy when it comes to the price.

Emre Yakışır was super responsive and friendly in every interaction we had. He promptly helped us and answered any questions we had, and even accommodated any extra needs. The bed is super comfy, there's internal heating and AC, which works perfectly well, a washing machine (which for us was a lifesaver), and an elevator (quite handy, given the apartment is located in the top floor). The areas are spacious, and we loved staying here for 1 week. The neighbourhood is lovely, right in the center of Cihangir, you couldn't be better located!
We will certainly be coming back.

reviews.text: Ibrahim is a very respectable, helpful and responsive. The house was like the photos and the video he send it to me , very clean. The building is clean and quiet and in a very nice place; in a main street. All we needed is around us, metro station, bus station are 1 min walking distance from the home.. a lots of restaurants and it’s a very nice shopping area.. I highly recommend it.

Wonderful First-Time Airbnb Experience!
I wanted to share an honest review of my stay. This was my very first time booking an apartment through Airbnb, and it was a genuinely wonderful experience!
We stayed from the 25th to the 28th of October. The hosts were incredibly kind and gracious. They were so helpful, even assisting us with our luggage, and were always very responsive to any questions we had. description: Stay in a historic 200-year-old flat with 3.5m spacious high ceilings and authentic wooden floors, located at the entrance of Istiklal Street and just 2 minutes from Galata Tower & Şişhane Metro. reviews.text:
The apartment location is perfect. Away from the crazy but just a few minute walk from Galata tower.
The apartment was reaaally clean! The bathroom is a bit small but honestly the water pressure is great and also super clean.
The host was very responsive - he also let me know the room was available earlier than check in time.
The room is on the first floor but the stairs aren’t as steep or crazy as other places.
We stayed here for 4 nights and it was great having a washing machine as well.
Highly recommend! :)

Konum mükemmel. Tünel'den Şişhaneye inen ana cadde üzerinde. Eski bir apartman. 1nci katta ve geniş merdivenli. Çıkmak valizlerle bile çok kolay. Merdivenler ahşap (apartman merdivenlerine hayran kaldık) ve dairenin yerleri de ahşap. Pencereler de eski stil ve harika. Evde ihtiyacınız olacak her şey var. Oturma alanı/salon oldukça geniş. Yatak odası bir perde ile ayrılıyor, kapı yok, 2 kişiden fazla kalacakların bilgisine. Tam boy buzdolabı ve mutfak eşyaları var. Ev sahibi saat 7'ye kadar alttaki dükkanda ve ne ihtiyacınız olursa anında ulaşılabilir. Ev kombi ya da klima değil, salonda elektrikli petek ve yatak odasında elektrikli kaloriferle ısıtmalı. Özetle tavsiye edilir, tekrar gidilir :)

I booked this late the night before I arrived and they were ready and communicative, it was very easy to find. I wanted something close to the metro and this spot is basically two minutes away (steps near metro also good sunset watching location, btw).
While the apartment is very well insulated from street noise, I will note that there is sound transfer between floors. Given that it’s on the 2nd floor, you’ll also probably get some smoke wafting up from street level. This wasn’t a problem for me (and typical of most older buildings) but mentioning if you’re sensitive.
In all, really enjoyed my stay.
Very well located, clean and beautiful apartment. The bed was comfortable and the kitchen space small but fuctional.
The apartment is perfectly located to see my places in Istanbul by foot. The photos and description are accurate. Check in and support/service during our stay was excellent.

Seyehate birkaç gün kala son anda bulup karar değiştirdiğimiz ve seçtiğimiz bir konaklama yeri, pencereden deniz manzarasi var diye tercih ettim ve gayet memnun kaldık. Well decorated, comfy, have class design, comfy bed, big sofa, nice TV and full kitchen, bathroom was also clean and large, only disadvantage is elevator a bit narrow 😅 you need to be attentive. Everything works and was perfect. Thank you. Highly recommended!

I stayed here for 2 weeks. I enjoyed my stay. The location is incredible. Right in front of tram station and bus stop , so easy hop on and off . 10 minutes walk to galata port, 10 minutes walk to taksim square. 20 minutes walk to galata tower. 20 minutes walk to Eminonu. Location is amazing. The apartment is in front of a busy road, but it’s not facing it, so do expect noise all throughout the day and night, but that’s something you deal with all over Istanbul. I do have to mention that the apartment looked bigger in the pictures, but when I saw it in real life it was smaller. There is an elevator but it fits 1 person and a half. This apartment is perfect for up to two people. the bed was comfy, the bathroom was clean., location is amazing. The building feels newly remodeled. Full kitchen. I ran out of toilet paper, I requested it, and they provided it quickly. They also have shampoo and body wash in the bathroom. I also used the washing machine multiple times. I will book this again.

Firstly great location right opposite a tram stop and few min walk to the funicular to Taksim. The apartment was super clean and pristine like the pictures, modern, comfortable bed and easy check in. Host kept in touch but thankfully didn't need anything. Highly recommended. Would stay again if in Istanbul.

Good location near a tram stop, had everything needed inside, bed was very comfortable and there was plenty of storage space. Bathroom was lovely and shower was good. Looked like the pictures, but not a place full of homely touches - has more of a hotel-style feeling. Communication was fine, though I had to add Ra on a popular messaging app and contact him ahead of our stay to receive check-in details - wasn't the most proactive in that sense but was fine enough.

description: Centrally located studio is only 10-15 minutes away from Blue Mosque & Hagia Sophia Square by walking.

reviews.text:
This was a great spot in Istanbul close to everything that we needed for our family of 5 travelling on a tight budget. Grocery stores (Bim/Kim and Sok) across the square, walkable to major sites (15 mins to Hagia Sophia, 12 mins to a metro stop, 30 mins to Grand Bazaar). Quiet area, friendly neighbours. Great little shops for souvenirs down the road that don’t get a lot of foot traffic, so prices are good.
Restaurants in the area, though we didn’t eat out. 20 minute walk to the waterfront and a nice park with playground equipment, and a park across the road from the hotel too, in a nice leafy area
The room was as expected: a tight fit for 5 people but we managed just fine. Bathroom was small but functional though the sink didn’t drain well. We appreciated the 2-burner hot plate, fridge, and basic kitchen supplies to cook meals.
Our host was there part time at the hotel main desk but was always responsive to questions by messaging.
We were very satisfied with our stay.

This was my first time in Turkey and from the beginning I felt so welcomed. The host was always so nice and helpful and accessible to anything we needed. Great place! I don’t think the pictures do it’s justice! Awesome place and people! Always felt so safe event walking at midnight.

we spent great time in this apartment.cleanliness is upto the mark with nice towel setting and complimentary disposable carpet shoes which were really helpful.Everything was spot on as it was discribed. This place is best if you want to walk to Blue Mosque,Hagia sofia and there is nice nightlife just few streets away in Kumkapi.highly recommended!

We had a really wonderful stay and are very satisfied!
The location is simply perfect .very central and everything is nearby: the Blue Mosque, the sea, shops, and public transport. Despite being so central, it is pleasantly quiet, which we really appreciated.
The accommodation was very clean, and the room was cleaned daily. The staff were always very friendly and helpful, and they answered all our questions, including providing helpful information about the city.
We stayed as a family with teenagers and younger children, and it was perfect for all of us.
We can truly recommend this place and would definitely come back anytime!
Konaklama yeri ve konumu güzeldi. Odalar güzeldi, temizdi, nevresim ve çarşaflar yeni ve temizdi. Yani konaklanabilir bir yer fiyat bakımından da iyi.

Sinan place is newly renovated and everything was perfect and clean.

3 A/C (1 in living room, 2 in bedrooms ) one bedroom without AC & flexible check-in was a plus 👍🏻.

The apartment was clean and well-maintained, providing a welcoming home away from home. The central location was perfect, allowing us easy access to many of the city's attractions and amenities. We highly recommend Sinan's place for anyone looking for a convenient and pleasant stay in the heart of the city.

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Sultanahmet Apart & Suites: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Sultanahmet is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, our mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text:
The place was exactly as described and pictured. It fit our needs perfectly for me, my husband and our adult daughter. The apartment was a good value. The host communicated well. We opted for his roundtrip airport transfer option (90 euro). Very clear instructions were provided. The driver communicated with the host so a representative was there to greet us. Communication was great.
The place was very clean! We appreciated all of the electrical outlets, coffee and coffee maker, fridge, mirrors and countertops. The host was in contact with us and I'm sure would have accommodated the following suggestions but we were so busy seeing the sites, we didn't want to be a bother and contact him to make any of these minor requests - not sure if it is a Turkish thing, but there were no top sheets just blankets, the shower is not fully enclosed and some water gets on the floor, and bring your own hairdryer if you like it to be powerful.
None of these would prevent us from staying again. Thanks!

Awesome two-bedroom unit very close to the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sofia, and others. The room that accommodates a total of 3 people has two beds (one queen size and one single) divided by a partition, so each section has enough privacy. The beds are very comfortable and one can sleep very well and tight. There is a dining table big enough for 4 people to share a meal and even work on laptops. The balcony is not too spacious but nice enough to enjoy fresh air or a drink outside. The unit is equipped with a coffee brewer (free coffee powder included, and nice-tasting, by the way), a microwave, a kettle, and some basic silverware. The cleanliness of everything is remarkable.
Ercan and colleagues’ communication was clear, prompt, and well accommodating to our needs and requests. I thank them greatly for our memorable experience in Istanbul. Highly recommended for those looking for a conveniently located and comfortable space at reasonable prices.

This is possibly the best place one can find in Fatih area. Excellent location, quiet neighborhood, easy & fast communication, good sized apartment, super clean, comfortable beds, lots of amenities, great hot shower & more importantly, extremely helpful staff. They help you with everything - carrying your luggages, arranging transfers & excursions, showing you shopping areas, arranging pre-departure PCR tests, weighing your luggages... oh you name it, they are ever ready to assist.
Without a doubt, I will definitely stay here again & I highly recommend this place to everyone.

Good place to stay. Very close to the Blue Mosque and Haga Sophia. The road next to the flat has lots of restaurants for tourists.
The room looked the same as the photos, it was one large room with a wall divider. Nice paintings/photos on the walls.
Good kitchenette with a sink and fridge. There is even a machine to boil eggs.
It was clean and worth the stay. Just some small things like the TV didn't work, shower didn't stay on the hook and flooded after use. But other than that it was a good stay.

we had a great time at this place, initial planning is to spend last day at a hotel but we cancel it and extend a day.
the location is superb, a lot of landmark can be reach out by walking. Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia below 5 mins. Basilica Cistern below 10 mins. Grand Bazaar around 15 mins.
the property is also clean and is as shown on the picture.
the host is great and very responsive as well

description:
Having its own private entrance, it is the detached first floor of a two-storey house.

Located at a quiet street on the island, away from the daily crowd and tour paths, though just a 10 minutes walk to all amenities and centre, reachable without treading steep slopes.

60 square meter space is plain and bright, consists of two rooms, an open layout living room and dining area, a kitchen, and a bathroom

reviews.text:
Our stay was beyond our expectations!
First fo all Gökçe and Derya are wonderful and careful hosts.
Place is awesome. House is situated in a few quarters from crowded embankment. If you decide to walk around you will find a picturesque panoram of Istanbul.
House is neat and cozy. Hosts made a lot of efforts to choose appropriate furniture and to decorate it.
You’ll find all what your need for the comfortable stay: shower gel, shampoo, toast grill, hairdryer, sheets, nice pillows, etc. Hosts even orders you the delivery of water so you don’t need to lift heavy bottles from below.
Excellent! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Beautiful apartment, ideal for romantic getaways for couples. Great location, quiet, away from restaurants and most hotels, so there are no noise pollution. Place located in the centre of town, everything accessible by walking distance, also public transport available and bus stop is just round the corner.
Hosts are very friendly and extremely helpful with lots of tips about local amenities.
The place itself reminds a countryside house with authentic furniture, it was clean, and all necessities available.
We were feeling like at home in this beautiful apartment. Would recommend to stay here, and will come back in the future.

Gökçe ve Derya’s place was amazing!
It looked even better than in the pictures. There are so many cute details and the tiny kitchen was well prepared for a little welcome tea and snack! Its easy to reach from the ferry station but in a very quite street.
I can highly recommend this place beside one little thing. There is a water heating machine in the bedroom that makes sounds all night. If you have a problem sleeping with noise this might not be the best choice. Yet i would love to come again as such things dont bother me too much. Great hosts!!!

This apartment is a treasure that Gokce y Derya have furnished and accessorized with elegant simplicity and keen attention to the comfort and care of their guests. The bed is comfortable, the linens and towels are of excellent quality, the kitchen has an abundant array of dishes, utensils, and cookware, and the bathroom has fine hand soap and shower gels. There is even filtered water for drinking and cooking and a cut glass carafe of water by the bed.
The apartment is in a safe and quiet neighborhood above the town. It is an easy walk to restaurants, shops, and the bus station which is the hub for public transport.
Gokce y Derya are responsive, but non-intrusive, hosts who care about the comfort and care of their guests. I was encouraged to relax and feel at home during my stay. I had a lovely time in their home.

Gökçe and Derya are unparalleled hosts. They warmly welcomed us and were always immediately responsive, even treating us to freshly-picked mint leaves and artisan soaps. They recommended beautiful views and special things to see on the island that only locals would know.
The apartment is stunning. Every detail is chosen with an artist’s eye: beautiful stone floors, antique light fixtures, gorgeous furniture, lovely linens and pretty plants. The atmosphere is so pleasant to look at, but also very comfortable to live in—beautiful but laidback.
Ideal location--a quick walk to the ferries, but situated off the touristic path.
We stayed four months and felt very much at home. There is a weekly farmers’ market just down the hill: olives, cheeses, breads, spices and excellent fresh produce. The neighborhood cats are lovely visitors, and the breeze in the island trees is your relaxing soundtrack.
Gökçe and Derya’s space is inviting, clean and cozy, and their hospitality is exquisite.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Inside a residential complex, a room and a large living room. Inside the complex, there is a covered summer and winter swimming pool, a gym, a Turkish bath, a private garden, a parking garage, 24/7 security, near the bus station, supermarket, and restaurants

reviews.text: The apartment is exactly as described , apartment has everything you could need for long or short stays. The host mossab was polite, professional and excellent to always accommodate us. Thank again for excellent stay

Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum. Burada 1 hafta kaldık bugün çıkıyoruz. Ev sahibimiz Mosaab yardımsever, samimi ve çok anlayışlı birisi. Ev resimlerdekiyle aynı ve ihtiyacımız olan herşey vardı. Bizim için sessizlik önemliydi, burası sessiz ve huzurluydu. Market hemen binanın altında ve merkezi konumda ulaşım kolay. Mosaab'a tekrardan teşekkür ediyorum.

The apartment totally met my expectations. It's commodious, good for long -term staying. Grocery and pharmacy are just nearby. There is plenty of room to store the clothes, dishes, shoes... Mosaab is super helpful, he even went above and beyond with addressing my requests. Neighborhood is nice, walkable distance to 3 Metrobus stations, and it's 12th floor, so you'll have a bird-eye view. All in all great apartment and amazing host.

Musaab IAan awesome host! my family stayed at his appointment for about 10-12 days and they were so happy. The apartment is in very good condition and centrally located. Everything is close by, shops, shopping mall and public transportations. Thanks again Musaab and we will definitely stay at your place if we ce to Istanbul also we will recommend you to our friends and family.
Wonderful host. Super clean place. Recommend ing to anyone who wants a tidy and calm neighbourhood.

description:
great city view on 31st floor. very luxerious residance. modern equipments. most stylish furnitures.

sauna gym turkish bath indoor pool outdoor pool unlimited use for only guests staying over 7 days and included the price.

100 mbps unlimited wifi.

full equiped kitchen equipments.

reviews.text: The apartment was clean and well equipped. The location is great and accessible to great malls, restaurants and more. And lastly, Veli was very responsive and helpful. I'd definitely book this place again. Thanks Veli:)

Her zaman İstanbul a geldiğimde otelde kalıyordum ama bu sefer evimin rahatlığını aratmayan temiz düzenli aynı zaman da ihtiyaçlarımıza cevap verecek bir ortamda konakladım. İlk denemem çok başarılı idi…Zannediyorum bundan sonra hep böyle olacak. Teşekkür ederim ev sahibimiz. Teşekkürler Airbnb.

Very central and clean house. House is shining with well cleaning. Towels and bad sheets was very clean and smelling softener. It was really nice.All equipments we could reach easily for cooking.kitchen is full.
Metro is 10 minute walking; bus station is 4 minute walking distance.
Postion is very strategic that we could reach so much place between 2 to 5 usd range via taxi. Reception calls taxi 7-24 if you request they ussually come in 3 minute.
House windows was bottom to top and view was great.
The residance has security for 24 hrs.
Ev çok temiz ve en küçük ayrıntıya kadar herşey düşünülmüş.konumu heryere yakın ve ev sahibi iletişimi hızlı ve samimiydi çok memnun kaldık teşekkür ederiz.

The apartment is clean and has a good location. There is a Carrefour in the complex. The host is quick to respond. The apartment consists of three rooms,living room and two bathrooms. The air conditioner is only in the main room and living rooms .

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet, centrally located and safe place on the European side. You can reach the center or bus stops in 5 minutes, the ferry or Nişantaşı in 15 minutes by walking. 10 minutes to Taksim or Havataş by taxi.

Enjoy a simple, comfortable and safe stay in this centrally located quiet place. You can reach the center or bus stops in 5 minutes on foot, and the ferry and Nişantaşı in 15 minutes. Taksim and Havataş are 10 minutes away by taxi.

reviews.text:
Gül and Damla were great hosts, very communicative and they also gave me clear instructions about how to check in. I feel lucky that I found their place in the last minute, as there are not so many apartment options within the price range that has an elevator in the building.
Their apartment has everything needed for a short stay. Quiet environment in a safe location in the city center, and it's within walkin distances to parks and bars!
The room was comfortable, I slept very well during my stay there. I even managed to sleep 12++ hours oj the first night after a long bus ride from Georgia. I would recommend it in a heartbeat!

Gül and Damla are very friendly and welcoming hosts. It was a pleasure to chat with them. Thanks for the delicious Turkish coffee. I only wish the cat liked being hugged and petted. The apartment is clean and tidy. The spacious living room was comfortable to work in. I also liked the location, many entertaining centers are quite close. Highly recommend.

I booked the room as a result of my urgent need for accommodation in Istanbul for 3 nights. The fact that it was a superhost and received positive comments was a factor in my choice. We had a very positive dialogue in the first period. When I came home, Ms. Damla welcomed me positively and showed me the room. From this point on, I started to be ignored, and Ms. Gül made every effort to avoid encountering me from the very beginning. I wish they had never accepted me, if they would have been so uncomfortable. From the first moment I felt very uncomfortable at home, I tried not to leave the room and I felt very uneasy when using the bathroom and kitchen. I would not recommend anyone to stay at Gül Hanım, they may take your money and make you feel very uncomfortable. Apart from this, the refrigerators were full, they were only able to make enough space for me to put one bag of mine. On my 2nd night, they interrupted my sleep for 1 hour as a result of a very noisy kitchen activity at 3am.

It is my 2nd time to stay this house and I feel like at home. Here is very quiet place even it is located in the center. Hosts are great. Home is comfortable and in a family apartment. Location is safe 24 hours. Highly recommended!

Damla and Nesti are amazing hosts, they are very friendly, chill and helped me a lot with some transportation questions!
The apartment is located in a very good area in Besiktas- it’s very safe (as a girl I didn’t have any problems with getting back home alone at midnight), the neighbourhood is surrounded by parks. I really liked that area after living near Taksim for one month.
Apartment is very clean and cozy, the room is quite simple but the hugest advantage is that it actually has a window looking at the street (I was living with the windows looking to another buildings all the time in Turkey😂)
I would highly recommend staying in this apartment!!

description: Our apartment is located in the center of Sultanahmet, a few minutes' walk from historical places and transportation. Daily cleaning service is available. Our apartment is a 2-minute walk from Sultanahmet Square, 1 minute from the Gülhane tram and 2 minutes from the Sultanahmet tram. It has a large balcony and a view of Hagia Sophia.

reviews.text: The apartment is basic but very clean and comfortable, with a fantastic view of Hagia Sophia and the Topkapi palace skyline. The location is also fantastic - right in the heart of Sultanahmet and a 5min walk to the tram station for trips further away. The only downside is a slightly erratic hot water supply to the shower which left us rather too revitalised some mornings. Muharem is a very friendly and helpful host, who promptly arranged our airport transfers.

Excellent stay
Don’t miss it
Spotless, excellent communication, incredibly accommodating, organised airport transfers. Washing machine a good send ( august hot in Istanbul )
A few minutes walk to the big ticket tourist sites
One must factor in Turkish building standards so apartment fittings are a bit ‘ the house that Jack built’. The host has made the best out of the property and it’s excellent for the price. Highly recommend and will happily stay again

-Nice view of the Ayasofya mosque from the balcony and windows.
-Very well located and close to everything
-Spacious (Perfect for 2)
-Very Clean
-Quick response and helpful staff
-Great Price/Value

An amazing location and a beautiful property, with a nice balcony that looks right out at the Hagia Sophia. Many good restaurants, historic sites, and museums within short walking distance.
Property was very well kept and spotless clean, including the Bathroom.
Muharem was an amazing hostess and was very responsive. I would highly suggest a stay in this property!

Great location, extremely near to the most visited attractions, walking distance to the port, all the restaurants and shops you can imagine within 5 minutes walk.
Big apartment for 2 with all necessary, clean, open to check-in early or leave your luggage, veey friendly staff. Highly recommended for a stay in Istanbul.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. It has a sea view, is furnished, bills are included, it is a 1+0, and has a bathroom and a kitchen. We have a total of 3 apartments in the same building. We can rent to 3 different families separately. Earthquake-resistant complete curtain concrete walls (concrete) have been built.

reviews.text:
Fantastic quirky area. Shoe making district. Steep narrow cobbled streets, bustling with shoe makers, traders, tea sellers and lively local life. İlker’s place is a stone’s throw from all the major sites, lovely side-balcony view on the busy Bosphorous shipping lanes… fascinating to see a live port in action. Five minutes from tramway and ancient covered Bazar… eating places everywhere. Quite noisy so not for those who are looking for peace and quiet.
Positives: self contained, safe bedsit. Wonderful hot power shower. Comfy sofa. Nice looking TV which we never used. Nice kettle and coffee maker. Excellently situated and character merchant’s house design. Great huge fridge and freezer. Good wifi. Washing machine… we didn’t use it so we don’t know how good it was. Good value for money. We stayed a month.
Negatives: no welcome at the beginning, or clear instructions how to find the place. No introduction to the flat. No instructions how to work the washing machine which was only in Turkish. Very uncomfortable double bed. Dilapidated cupboards in the kitchen and lack of crockery and mugs. No hangers in the wardrobe.
The cleaner only comes on Sunday so you’d have to stay in if you wanted her to clean. There was a lovely balcony but no effort had been made to clean it or put a couple of chairs and a table out there. It was all a bit derelict.
No towels or toilet paper ready in the flat and we finally found a pile of linen on a shelf on the landing.
I don’t want to appear negative and the negatives would be easily solvable. It was a good and safe place for a month, but with a few nice touches it could be made even better.
Sadly next year the price is increasing considerably and İlker is only renting it for max 27 days.

Both Ilker and his associate Murat are wonderful genuine men. If there is anything needed they will gladly work with you, they are really respectful and kind. It is obvious they care about their location and their tenants and I feel very comfortable in the spaces they provide. I have enjoyed my stay so much I will be extending my stay and I appreciate the kindness and flexibility offered. If you plan to work I just suggest you ask for a hardline connection or a wifi extender, as a mobile worker I know the importance of having solid internet.. I strongly recommend staying here, as it is clean, private, has a nice view on the balcony and locals will look out for you if attempt to connect with them with basic Turkish and nice energy.. I frequent Istanbul a lot a musician and I will always contact Ilker and Murat first before I attempt to stay anywhere else in Istanbul! Thank you so much 🙏🏾

Good location with very nice view in a lively area, within walking distance of the Grand Bazar, Hagia Sofia and other tourist atractions.
The host was helpful and the apartment was equiped with everything necessary, even for a long stay.
The internet is reliable and there is a working space.
I enjoyed my stay here and i will come again next time I will be in Istanbul.
.. a very good central place, good location, accessible and with everything you need to enjoy and get to know the city... good communication with the very friendly host!!

Nice clean apartment it’s have air conditioner washing machine more than one bed it can fit 4 people easily it have a kitchen to cook your meals in the night quiet but in the day time a little bit noisy and it has a partial view of the sea in general it’s good apartment

Enjoy a great travel experience in this strategic home.

I loved how clean and cozy the apartment was. The high-pressure shower, the bed, and fast internet… to name a few.
I would absolutely stay here again :)
Yaqota’s apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. He communicates quickly and is very accommodating. Thanks again! Would highly recommend for anyone visiting.

description:
🏡

Enjoy modern comfort just 7 minutes from the Bosphorus in the heart of Istanbul. This stylish 2BR apartment features 3 A/C units, a breezy terrace, full kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and Netflix—everything you need to relax after exploring the city. Ideal for families, couples, solo travelers, and friends seeking both convenience and a local touch in vibrant Beşiktaş.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The apartment was clean, and exactly as shown in the photos (nothing less, nothing more).
The best part of the experience was definitely Caner, the host. He was extremely responsive, always available to answer our questions, and genuinely friendly , honestly one of the best hosts we’ve ever booked with as a group.
The location is amazing! It’s a very active area with plenty of cafés, pubs, restaurants, and shops all around, which gave us so many options just steps away from the apartment. At the same time, it still felt comfortable and safe to come back to after a busy day.
The place was also well-equipped with everything from cutlery and kitchen essentials and if anything is needed , i am sure if you asked for, Caner would respond quickly:)
Overall, it was a great experience and we would definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay at Caner’s apartment. The location is great, as you have a lot of cafes and restaurants downstairs. Despite the fact that the street downstairs is crowded and loud, the noise reaching the 3rd floor, where the flat is located, wasn’t as loud as expected. I think the value for money you get is more than fair! Everything was clean and tidy and according to the displayed pictures.

The apartment is located in the famous Besiktas district. Caner and his wife welcomed us personally, even though we arrived three hours late. The apartment is very nice, clean, large and there is a fully equipped kitchen and a washing machine. The beds are very comfortable and there are closets in each room. The apartment has a small balcony and air conditioning that works perfectly. Wi-Fi also worked great. Right next to the house there are great coffee's, stores and the best CigKöfte in town. Besiktas harbor / Besiktas Meydan is only 500m from the apartment. There are ferries that takes you to most of the sights for 7 lira. We used as transportation mainly the metro and the ferries. With the Istanbul card it works great, it´s fast and easy. At Besiktas Meydan there is also a direct bus connection to IST - Airport (the HavaIST line), which is great and went quickly. We were at the airport in 50 min. Communication with Caner was great, he always answered immediately when we had questions . we can highly recommend this accommodation

Our family of four spent three wonderful weeks at Caner’s lovely apartment in Beşiktaş, and we couldn’t have asked for a better stay. The home was extremely clean, comfortable, and perfectly set up for a longer visit. The strong air conditioning and in‑unit washing machine were huge bonuses, especially with two young kids.The neighborhood is fantastic — safe, friendly, and full of life. Everything you need is within walking distance: great restaurants, grocery stores, bakeries, and shops. Most places were literally across the street or just a few steps away. Caner was an outstanding host. He responded quickly to every question and shared a great PDF of fun things to do in the area. We felt truly cared for throughout our stay. We would happily return and highly recommend this home to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Airbnb’deki ilk konaklamamızdı. Korkularımız vardı ancak muhteşem bir süreç geçirdik. Evin konumu muhteşem. 4 yetişkin 2 çocuk çok rahat konakladık. Yataklar, yastıklar, çarşaflar, mutfak malzemeleri çok yeterliydi. Her yer tertemizdi. Şansımıza hiç otopark sorunu yaşamadık. Kapının önünde hep boş bir yer vardı araba için. Ev sahibimiz Caner Bey muhteşem ilgiliydi. Tüm sorularımızı yanıtladı. Sürekli bir ihtiyacımız olup olmadığını sordu. İlgisi alakası çok güzeldi. Bir daha konaklama yapacak olursak kesinlikle yine kendilerini ve evini tercih edeceğiz.

description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

reviews.text: I had a fantastic stay at Vahap's place! The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was perfect, with easy access to local attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. Vahap was an amazing host—very responsive, friendly, and always ready to help with any questions I had. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free. I felt right at home during my stay and would highly recommend Vahap's place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay. I would definitely stay here again!

Worth every penny. The caretaker guys were responsive and helpful. Although, you have to walk uphill to reach this place but it’s worth the price. Quite close to the Grand Bazaar and major Tourist Attractions.
Would surely recommend.

Nice safe home. Has every facility as listed. Location is a bit away from bus or metro station. Thanks to our host and his colleagues for helping us check in late in the night without any hassle. Good for the price 👍
This place was great for a long term stay. It has everything you need and the host was responsive and helpful. The location was great and within a short walking distance of the Grand Bazar.

We stayed in this apartment in August 2024. Place is very good, it’s close to two different metros. People were complaining about having to walk uphill but it’s only from one station. From another one it’s not a problem. Also, all the problems that we had were fixed very quickly. Vahap was on contact all the time and did everything to make us feel comfortable. I recommend this apartment 100% !

description:
Our historic 4.5-story apartment is located on one of the most beautiful streets of the Historic Peninsula. There is also a small terrace in our building. We are within a 10-minute walk to the Sultanahmet Mosque. Our room is 26
m² and air conditioning, double bed + single
kettle, wardrobe, private bathroom/toilet.

Important Note: We cannot accept unmarried couples.

reviews.text:
We stay here for 4 nights and it was very conveniently located—about a 10-15 min walk to all the main tourist attractions while still being local enough to get some really good valued food.
Carolina was very responsive and her friend, Ramazan and the older gentleman, who helps around the guesthouse, were all very accommodating. Ramazan also gave us some useful tips which was well appreciated!
Although the directions are clear, there was no signage for the guesthouse and we found it difficult to locate as we arrived quite late in the evening and there was no one immediately there. However, Ramazan was very responsive through the phone in getting us checked in.
There was an issue with the room we booked for the first night and we had to stay in a smaller room which was a bit disappointing as the bed and room was pretty small and we found it difficult to sleep in. However, we understand that unforeseen circumstances do happen and they moved us to another room (same layout as the one we booked) as soon as other guests checked out the following day.
The rooms are very nicely decorated but, because this is a new guesthouse, there are a few things that were not screwed in properly and kinda fell apart (in both rooms, the toilet seat only had one screw in so it moved around a lot, the toilet paper holder fell down and the towel holder fell apart as well)—just small things that perhaps should be fixed for future guests. The shower room is also not leveled/has no divider so future guests should know that the entire floor gets quite wet after showering. Noise also carries through the building and a section of the door is glass with white paint over it so light does come in from the hallway—it didn’t bother us much but other people may find it annoying.
All in all, it was a good stay for good value!

I can only recommend this place! Located on a quiet street near some of the main sights in Istanbul, a clean place with all you need for your stay. Carolina is very kind, as is the staff working there. She reacted very quickly after we were scammed in another hotel and we could directly move to her place. Good value for the price paid!

Very hard to go up or down on the stairs specially if you have a suitcase. You pretty much risk your life if you fall from the slippery sharp edged stairs! Asked for clean towels after few days and was not available at the time and promised to bring them in the morning but they never showed up. Other than that apartment itself is okay for the price you pay for being in the old part of Istanbul and being closer to the bazar. My overall score is 3.2 out of 5 for this place.

The place was clean, Carolina is a superhost that i highly recommend, she was proactive to all our requests and assisting us with transportation and advices, ... it's like 10 min walk to the blue mosque and 10 min away from Beyazit tram station ... we're definitely coming back
Carolina's was a great host! The bnb was very central and you can walk to many sites easily find there. Restaurants and shops are very close too. The place was cute and clean. highly recommend!

description: Looking for a spacious, stylish, and family-friendly stay in Istanbul? This newly renovated 3-bedroom flat combines Scandinavian design with practical comfort, making it perfect for families, groups, or travelers with children.

reviews.text:
We really enjoyed staying at Doruk’s apartment.
The living area and the main bedroom were perfect!
It was so nice to be able to sleep with the window open. Both the main living area and main bedroom had aircon which most welcome at the end of a hot and tiring day exploring Istanbul.
However, the other 2 bedroom do not have windows looking outside and did not have air on or a fan, which made them quite hot to sleep in - however I passed this information on to Doruk and I think they have plans to rectify this in the future.
The location was perfect and we felt very comfortable in this apartment. It was clean and very spacious. Overall we would definitely stay here again.
We also found that if we had any questions that our messages were responded to immediately. Communication was perfect. We also loved having a code to both the Main Street door and the front door. We never had to worry about trying to find a key.
Overall I highly recommend Doruk’s apartment. 🤩

Doruk & his team were always very friendly, responsive & helpful - great hosts!
The place has a great location; tons of bars, restaurants & supermarkets in the area.
The bathrooms were clean but smelled very bad (probably from the drains, because it’s an old building). Most doors in the flat are quite loud / squeaky, which wasn’t ideal late at night for early sleepers. The hinges could be oiled..it would also be nice to have a place to hang towels, instead of having to put them on furniture.
In one of them bedrooms there was also no handle on the window.
All in all the place is nice, spacious and comfortable - but could do with a little care.

The apartment is spacious, the cleanliness is 10/10, especially the bed linen, which I think is new 👍🏻،
-There is no external view .
-There are no blackout curtains for the room .
The area is beautiful, for those who want to shop, there is Nişantaşı near it, in addition to a group of cafes and restaurants
Doruk is a very helpful person,I made an early check-in , in addition to try to solve all the problems I faced .
Guys from the company were very friendly , helpful, and operative in answers ! Apparent was very clean, and matched the photos. A bit old, but it didn’t disturb our stay!!!

This is the top 1 house I’ve stayed in Istanbul.
Location: it is located in a street that is closed to everything you need, restaurants, gym, shopping street, pier etc and yet it is quiet!
Room: The decor for this house is warm like home. There are 2 bedrooms plus one kid room. And 2 restrooms. Living room got a big screen for Netflix , and a comfy sofa. Honestly, I’d stay in this place for a long term if I’ve ever coming back to Istanbul again.
Host: fast in replying messages, and answer everything you need.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. The studios are available for long term rental only. Taksim is 10 minutes by walk and chic and luxurious Nisantasi shopping district is just minutes away by foot. The location is 2 minutes to Osmanbey metro station by foot. The studios are newly refurbished. If you are already in Istanbul and would like to take a look before renting for long term, you are more than welcome. For shorter stays follow us on ig at roxy.apartments

reviews.text:
This Airbnb was just perfect! For our first time in Istanbul, could not have found a better location. It’s right next to the metro station and a couple blocks from the bus stop making it easy and convenient to get anywhere in the city. Also walkable to the ferry station. The room itself was also fantastic. Had a full kitchen so we were able to make our own breakfast and heat up leftovers from restaurants. It was very clean and spacious. I had a fantastic time in Istanbul and the Airbnb had a lot to do with how smoothly our whole trip went!
Ezgi was a great host - extremely responsive to any questions we had and provided all the information proactively that made check-in so easy and smooth!

Flet is very cute and totally new/renovated. I like the place very much :)
The sleeping was good, because the area it's not loud. Internet connection is really good, I did not have any problems working on remote for one month from this flet. Ezgi was always very responsive and flet has a really good location, near metro and bus stations. It is a perfect choice for a studio in Nisantasi area.
There are 2 things I would like mention, but none of this things would change mind about my stay. I would still chose it, those are only recommendations:
-I would suggest have 3-4 cooking appliances more (because it is hard to prepare something with almost nothing in the kitchen)
-The washing machine has some problems, while cleaning white clothes. Even it has been checked, it's true, because other guest had same "problems".
Thank you Ezgi for everything :)
Very nice apartment. Walk distance to the nearest metro station. The Host is very responsive. Fully recommended.

reviews.text: Our stay was not what was expected. The location is great as is very central to everything in Old Istanbul. Parking is free in premises which was convenient and the host was very friendly and accommodating (although unable to speak English so unable to offer tips/advice on the area). The wifi did not work in the room and the room itself was noisy as was on back of property on a busy road. walls are incredibly thin and room was hot and stuffy as we needed to keep windows closed due to noise. The bed was also uncomfortable because of springs. Unfortunately this left us with a rather negative experience especially given the price of the room.

First of all, I would like to say that this hotel is great value for money! It was our oasis of peace in big noisy city of Istanbul :) In more details
1) Location. Is not perfect, but very good. The closest tourist spot is Grand Bazaar (5-7 min walk uphill), where we usually took tram or metro to get elsewhere. Sultanahmet is more like 30 min walk on the noisy busy streets, so we only went once by foot. Yenikapi metro station(to go to the airport etc) is 20 min walk, also not easy with the luggage, so mind that.
The area close to the Bazaar has plenty of shops, street food, restaurants etc, no problem with that even at night. The hotel street itself is very quiet.
Sea view - is actually a view on the railway and very busy seaside road with heavy traffic :) Didn't mind that as we were exhausted and slept well regardless of anything :) But actually there's no seaside walk possibility etc.
2) The hotel itself is really new! Recently renovated. The interior is super nice. Extreme cleanliness and everything is new and shiny. The room is really very very small, so no big luggage bags :) The shower - is just hanging on the wall in the toilet, so mind that all the bathroom is wet after having a shower.
Terrace on the 2nd floor is nice, but noisy because of the road below. Common kitchen is super, spacious and convenient.
3) Breakfast - costs 15 TL, is traditional Turkish set (vegatables, boiled egg, bread, butter, cheese, ham). Does include instant coffee only, or tea. We asked for Turkish coffee instead, it costs 5 TL. The breakfast is not what can get you going for the whole day or even half, but there's a possibility to order additional dishes from the menu.
4) Staff. I communicated with Can on the website in English, very quick responses and good experience, but we didn't actually meet in the hotel. We were met by another guy (Timur I think) who speaks good Russian. Overall experience was ok, perhaps it would be good to have more additional information, tips, instructions (which you actually need a lot in Istanbul). Timur gave us the Istanbulkart on the first day, which was very important, many thanks for that!!
Thank you for your hospitality!

Everything was like described in listing. Mert and Can were really nice hosts, friendly and ready for help. This place is really nice and I would gladly recommend it to anyone coming to Istanbul because:
-It's really near to all main turistical areas
-neighbourhood is peaceful
-place is clean and it has everything mentioned.

If we come back to Istanbul we are coming here for sure.

Very Good location Fatih: Sultan Ahmet /Hagia Sofya 15 min walk, To Grand Baazar /Ferry station 25-35 min walk. The hotel totally fits the photo, yes, rooms are compact even phisically they are small, but all the stuff in room, bath organized perfect. Shower works perfect. The kettle in the room with tea bags is advantage always.

The place was good and clean. The location is not prime but not bad as well, it is just 15 mins by foot from the attractions. The bed & the room was smaller than the expectations & than it looks in the photos. The room is fine for 1 person but not for 2. The washroom is strangely smaller. But the rest everything was ok.

description: This 55 sqm apartment for 5 people is elegantly and exquisitely decorated and has everything you need. The entrance to the building is next to the Galata Tower and offers you the best location within walking distance of most tourist attractions such as Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Square, Karakoy and Eminonu. The area is surrounded by trendy cafes, art galleries, unique shops and a vibrant atmosphere. A fully equipped kitchen allows you to cook your own meals

reviews.text:
The apartment was excellent, exactly as described. We especially enjoyed the terrace and its views - during the sunset it is truly breathtaking.
Even though the apartment is situated in a tourist neighborhood, it is very quiet and peaceful.
We especially appreciated Bahar’s assistance during our stay. She was flexible about our check-in (a bit earlier than initially planned), helped us with our luggage (we did not have to take it upstairs ourselves - thank you once again!) and arranged a taxi for us for our travel to the airport (at a reasonable price). She was also so nice and friendly!
Really recommended!

Quiet location in Galata, the apartment is spacious and clean. The inside is slightly more dated than in the pictures, and could do with a makeover, but overall everything worked well. Bed is big and quite comfortable. Bathroom is older, shower and toilet could be fixed slightly, but worked well overall. Terrace is huge, with great views towards different directions of the city. Overall good quiet (important!) location in Galata.

Great location, excellent communication, and a wonderful vibe. We enjoyed the lively street music through the bathroom window, while the bedroom stayed quiet for a great night’s sleep. The stairs were a nice bonus for staying active and burning a few extra calories. The flexible check-out time was greatly appreciated. The host is beyond amazing!

We had a great stay at Okan's place in Istanbul, very well located with great views from the rooftop terrace. Check-in was very easy and whenever we had an issue (for example hot water was not working when we arrived and someone came immediately to fix it).
Great place, clean, simple, great views and location, easy checkin and Okan's team (Bahar) followed up with me at every step and was really helpful. Would stay here again.

description: Indulge in the heartbeat of Kadıköy from our doorstep! Dive into eclectic markets, savor diverse cuisines, and soak in the artsy vibe. Every convenience at hand ensures a seamless urban experience. Our chic oasis is more than a stay—it's your gateway to the city's pulsating energy. Immerse yourself, explore freely, and cherish the moments in this vibrant urban haven. A blend of comfort, culture, and adventure awaits!

reviews.text:
The place is very central in Kadiköy, around 10 min to the ferry but it's unbelievable silent for this great location. Restaurants and bars are close by and not only tourists spend there evenings here.
Kitchen is a little small and there was little space on the countertop and a lot of stuff in the fridge but other than that it was great.
The bed is super comfortable.
And the communication with Tolga was good as well. We arrived late in the evening and he helped to find the transportation to the flat. He dropped the keys at a nearby hotel which was easy to find. We could even stay few hours beyond checkout since our flight was late!
Would definitely come here again when back in Istanbul. Best place to stay to explore the city!

We returned to this place for a second time because the location and vibe was great. Unfortunately, we were very disappointed by several issues during our stay:

There's a reception and high security service.

reviews.text:

description:
Step into a thoughtfully designed home in the heart of Istanbul. This second floor one bedroom apartment blends modern comfort with a calm and serene atmosphere, offering a relaxing escape within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Ideal for both short getaways and longer stays.

Whether you are here to discover the city or work remotely, everything you need for a smooth and comfortable stay is right at your fingertips.

reviews.text:
Super clean and spacious apartment located in a quiet street in the best neighborhood of Istanbul. Beautifully designed and bright apartment with partial sea view. The most comfy bed ever! The fully equipped kitchen is amazing. There’s a supermarket just 2 minutes walk away.
The host team is very professional. The water heating system had some issues and they send someone to fix it right away. Overall a 10/10 experience. Highly recommended!!

Clean, beautiful apartment in a safe building and very central location. Lots of restaurants and eateries nearby, and a couple of groceries. 5-7 minutes walk down the slope to the Tophane tram station. the climb up may be tough though, but you can always take a taxi or the metro / tünel to the lower end of Istiklal and then walk down.
inside the apartment everything was good, except the bed mattress could definitely be more comfortable.
Great host: very helpful, responsive and accommodating.

We enjoyed our stay in this spacious, chill, clean, and quiet apartment very much. The host team was wonderful, communication was excellent and they were very helpful. The apartment is located on a quiet street, yet there are plenty of shops, cafés, and a supermarket all within a few minutes’ walk, with very little noise. A short uphill walk leads to the famous Istiklal Caddesi.
It’s a pleasant surprise to have two bathrooms in the apt, as well as the washer was appreciated (although it took a bit longer to finish than expected. :)). Access to the gym just down the street was also a plus. We also enjoyed the massage service booked through the gym.
Overall, it made the last few days of our visit to Istanbul a great experience.

This was my second time staying at this Noa building in Istanbul. Location is perfect, the space is clean, bright, and feels as close to a hotel as an AirBnB can feel. Clean linens, full kitchen, great wifi, and access to a great gym. Would totally recommend staying here!

My second time staying at this beautiful apartment! It’s just 3 minutes away on foot from the galata tower while on a rather quiet street. However during my one week stay in late July, I can hear some construction noise from nearby buildings when staying at the bedroom during daytime.
The host team is very helpful especially Ece!! I lost my phone in an gelato shop and she showed up to help me make the phone call to the shop so I was able to find it back!
A 10/10 experience!

description:
Charming apartment in the heart of Istanbul. Just 2 minutes away from amazing restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, and so much more. Unbeatable location with Galata Tower, Istiklal Street and Galataport only minutes away. The Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar are 20 min away.

Perfect for weekend getaway, work-from-home alternative, or cozy home base while exploring everything Istanbul has to offer.

reviews.text:
There are pros and cons to staying at Galateia. It has fabulous views not from the verandah which had many pots with dead un-watered and uncared for plants as well as a sad looking BBQ, but rather from the large picture windows which gave us never ending pleasure. We stayed on the third floor in apartment 7, your view may be different depending on the direction and floor. The bustling and fun Istiklal street and the Sishane metro are a few minutes’ walk up a steep cobbled street. If you decide to stay at Galateia you should be aware that the small street it is located on is a very steep cobbled lane which can be quite challenging to walk up, however walking downhill to the tram stop is the best way to get to major sites. There are many restaurants in the area and small shops to buy necessary supplies. You will need these as this is the only Airbnb, we have stayed in which does not provide a welcome package, as well as no kitchen basics. No salt and pepper, no dish soap, no dishwasher soap, no kitchen hand towels, no cleaning materials, no kitchen garbage bags and no coffee maker (although they supplied three coffee presses after we requested them). The kitchen counter is now rather old with a huge split on the surface, and the lack of basic essentials was disappointing for our seven-night stay. We left supplies for the next guests. There was no written information usually supplied by hosts as to where to throw out the garbage, or the best places to eat, a road map etc.
Our double room had one hand towel and two bath towels, we requested more, and they supplied them. The hot water was not working very well, and it was fixed quickly which did not adversely affect us. Our stay was pleasant, the apartment was quiet, the bed was comfortable, the staff were accessible. The views are amazing.

You will not find a better-located apartment in Beyoglu or even Istanbul, for that matter. It is ideal for all sorts of travellers. The apartment is over two floors and is big, comfortable and spacious with terrific views and extremely quiet.
If you are arriving, particularly if it is a late arrival, then the reception is in the building next door, go there for your keys. Again for late arrivals, there is no welcome pack so that you can make a sandwich or a cup of tea/coffee or suchlike. Equally, there are no cleaning materials or cloths for general kitchen cleaning.
We had one interaction with the owner, which was less than welcoming. I understood that we were in the wrong by not wearing a mask in the building, but we all know that there are many ways to skin a cat and the aggressive tone was very offputting. So we decided there and then to have no further communication with the owner. Only to receive another message that evening in the same aggressive tone.
The wearing of masks, under Turkish regulations as well as in most other countries, is for medical facilities or areas where they are likely to be crowded, like public transport. I think we were in a building with seven apartments, and over the course of the nine days, we never encountered another person visually or aurally.
Do not be put off by our review. Our review of the apartment is second to none, you will not be disappointed as distinct from the owner who may have been under pressure, I don't know, but I tell it as I found it.

What a lovely, lovely duplex/apartment! The location is superb, the view breathtaking! All the amenities one needs are available- public transportation to pots and pans, elevators to air conditioning, the Galateia residence is ideal for travelers staying in the heart of Beyoglu, Istanbul. The staff went above & beyond their call of duty to make me feel comfortable and at home. I highly recommend staying here- whether for a weekend or a season, I am sure you will share my sentiments regarding the housing and the hosts! My memories of Istanbul begin with Galateia :)

Galateia is a somewhat expensive but top class accommodation in Istanbul. The view and location were excellent (we stayed in third floor facing west and had a great view of the golden horn, your view may be different depending on the direction and floor). The hopping Istiklal street and the Sishane metro are a few minutes walk (on a steep uphill) and the Galata Tower is a few minutes downhill. Walk about 6-8 minutes downhill to the T1 tram stop Tophane which is the best way to get to major sites such as Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque etc. Plenty of restaurants all around.
I am generally turned off by Airbnb places with a long list of "rules", but Galateia stay was pleasant. The staff is easily accessible and friendly. The wifi was good. This property is expensive by local standards, but you get what you pay for: location, easy checkin/checkout, view, a good kitchen (though they don't provide kitchen basics like salt, dish soap, coffee maker), excellent a/c etc.
We really enjoyed our stay… great location near Galata Tower… very responsive service… very clean… enjoyed view of Bosphorus from the large open windows…

description:
If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family.

Şişli Square is only a 2-3 min walk from the Metro station and the popular Cevahir Mall.

description:
This 1BR apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

reviews.text:

The furniture wasn’t very new, but it was totally fine for a one-week vacation. The only downside was that the curtains didn’t seem properly installed, which made the place look a bit messy.

description:
Experience the perfect stay in Istanbul's historic peninsula!

This booking offers a fully equipped authentic apartment on a tranquil street in Karakoy with proximity to the Galata Port, Istanbul Modern Museum, vibrant nightlife, and public transit options, all just minutes away.

With a coffee shop to start your day on the ground floor, the famous Gümrük Restaurant serving delightful meals around the corner and our daily cleaning and concierge services, we ensure your vacation is memorable!

reviews.text: Fabulous stay , pictures are accurate and the accomodation is clean beds comfortable spacious bathroom and great hot shower and a little kitchen if you wish to cook however Istanbul is full of lovely restaurants, Elif ( Co host ) greeted us enthusiastically and was helpful with recommendations and very responsive ( she is charming ) can’t recommend this apartment enough !

Very nice place, accurately matches the pictures (even better as they have installed a small stove now, enough to prepare some basic dishes). The bed is very comfortable. The location is perfect, yet it’s a quiet street without any noise. The building is well maintained. The communication by the hosting team is very professional. Only minor negatives are the low shower pressure and lack of acoustic isolation between rooms. Would definitely stay again.

This location was a great deal. We were in walking distance of everything from Galata Tower, Bosphorus area, Taksim Square, The ferry to Kadikoy and even Grand Bazaar. The location is very central to all the tourist attractions.
The Airbnb is exactly as described and very clean. It is private so you don't hear the noise on the streets but still very accessible to all the fun stuff. If we come back to Istanbul, I would definitely book again.

This is a really nice apartment in a fun neighborhood. Walking distance to old town during the day and the more spacious Galata neighborhoods on the evening (for those who are in good walking shape).
Check in was very easy for this English-only traveler. Apartment was nicely furnished, comfortable and AC worked well.

As air BNBs go this was the most pleasant of my experiences. The following are the positive points that helped make my stay great.
- friendly, responsive and helpful host
- door code for building access
- elevator for access to the apartment's floor
- key card access to the flat
- fridge stocked with beverages
- coffee capsules available for the Nespresso machine
- laundry detergent and softener available for the washing machine
- possibility to have the flat cleaned and fresh towels furnished during my stay
- the electronic lock on the nightstand drawer providing a secure place to store valuables
- great location with easy access to local monuments and public transport
- great location for good restaurants
- different and labelled bins for recycling and rubbish located both in flat and in public spaces
I definitely want to rebook on my next visit to Istanbul!

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The place was clean and well-equipped, making it easy to feel comfortable right away. reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay with our group of 8 adults and 2 kids! The house is huge, perfectly set up for big gatherings, and features 5 master bedrooms—each with its own private bathroom and shower, which was amazing for privacy.The host was exceptionally responsive. When the AC turned off during a power outage, they fixed it remotely right away, and when we had a small issue with the keybox, they stopped by the next day to fix it in person. The neighborhood is great, very friendly, and offers easy access to the bus station and Taksim Square.A couple of minor notes for future guests: the kitchen is great for hosting, but you may want to bring or buy a couple of large cooking pots if you plan to make big meals. Also, the Wi-Fi could be a bit slow at times, which is something to keep in mind if anyone in your group needs to work remotely. Overall, though, it's a fantastic house and a wonderful host!

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and had an overall wonderful experience. The home was perfect for our needs, beautifully decorated, and very comfortable. One unique aspect was the bathroom layout, where the toilet was located within the shower area. While this was a bit unconventional, it didn’t detract too much from our enjoyment of the stay.
The highlight of our visit was the host’s exceptional hospitality. They provided the best food and activity recommendations, which truly enhanced our trip. Their suggestions made our experience in the area unforgettable. Especially accommodated our early check-in needs!
Thank you so much for hosting us! We had an amazing time and would love to stay again.

The only positive about this place is that it has 5 bathrooms. However, they are not built well. One kept flooding. They did live a squeegee in shower so u can push water into drain. How kind. The toilets are in the shower. The bathrooms are cramped. If you are expecting a living room for your group to gather there isn’t one. The place is five independent bedrooms and a cramped kitchen. We found ourselves having to sit on the stairs, in hallways and a tiny sofa put into the kitchen. If you’re expecting a kitchen with a fridge there is none. Sink gets clogged and is leaking underneath. We had to fix ourselves. A dining table to sit snd eat? No. Sit on the floor or stand because there isn’t one. Location? If you are expecting to be in Taksim square you are not. It’s a 15-30 minute walk. Neighbors are loud at night. The door doesn’t even open with code and you have to push hard even with the key. One nice thing- the little market across the street is convenient.

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Şişli, Turkey! The location is absolutely perfect — everything you need is just steps away, from great cafes and restaurants to shops and public transport. It made exploring Istanbul so easy and convenient.
The apartment itself was spotless — one of the cleanest places I’ve ever stayed in. You can tell the host really takes pride in maintaining it to a high standard. On top of that, the space is beautifully designed, with a modern yet cozy feel that made it instantly comfortable and relaxing.
Overall, this Airbnb exceeded my expectations in every way. If you’re looking for a place that combines convenience, cleanliness, and style, this is definitely the one. I would 100% stay here again!

This apartment was perfect for a big group, we each had an ensuite and the bedrooms were all large. They also all included a lounge. They all had aircon. Only downside of this place is the street is quite noisy and the curtains don’t block out the light well. The kitchen was equipped well enough although we didn’t use it. It was about a 30 minute walk to the river. A few coffee shops around the area which are good. The location suited us. The host was very responsive and flexible, allowing us to leave our bags longer. The interior design is really tasteful. Thanks for the stay!
